admkeys.title: Bot keys & chat seam
admkeys.lede: Each bot calls the site with its own key (the X-PATV-Key header) instead of the shared bot token. New keys observe for 7 days, then enforce the route families they used. Admins can look; only owners change anything, and every change is written to the admin audit log.
admkeys.owner_note: You can look, but only an owner (an admin whose linked chat account has Pepe's owner role) can change keys or switches.
admkeys.keys.help: A key is shown once, when it is made or rotated. Put it where that caller reads it: Pepe's admin panel (API keys, PATV caller key), a bot's PATV_KEY, or OPS_PATV_KEY in the site's .env for ops alerts.
admkeys.col.label: Label
admkeys.keys.secret_once: Copy this key now - it won't be shown again. Anyone who has it can act as this bot.
admkeys.set.enabled: Read the X-PATV-Key header (off = only the shared tokens count)
admkeys.set.fallback: Fall back to the shared token (counted)
admkeys.set.control_get_allow: Allow (VM pollers older than the POST claim)
admkeys.set.control_get_help: The VM supervisor picks up restart commands with POST /api/pepe/control/pending. Refuse the old GET once the route log shows only POST for it.
admkeys.scopes.help: The route families each key used while observing. After {days} days, tick the ones it needs and enforce: elsewhere the key counts for nothing and raises an ops alert - the shared token still decides there until that family refuses it (then 403). A route added later needs its family granted here first.
admkeys.fam.help: Every family seen with a key or the shared token. Its switch refuses the shared token there (keys still work). Switch a family on once its 14-day count is zero.
admkeys.legacy.banner: Shared bot token last used: {when}. Retire it after 14 days in a row at zero on prod and staging.
admkeys.legacy.discord: The Discord bot's shared token last used: {when}.
admkeys.legacy.help: Every request the shared tokens authenticated, by route and caller hint (token, client and address). This is the list of what still has to move to a key.
admkeys.events.help: Who listens on the spin and results stream. Observe changes nothing and counts. Enforce needs the spin owner's session or a bot key for a spin, a session for a gold wheel page, and keeps the OBS and homepage streams open but without names. Enforce only once both bots show up as key here.
admkeys.seam.help: The pieces the native chat hub will use. All of it stays quiet until it is configured: tickets need a key in the site's .env, and nothing is sent while no hub address is set.
admkeys.seam.hub_insecure: not sent: the hub address is plain http:// with no tailnet proxy (HUB_V1_PROXY)
admkeys.seam.switch.tickets: Chat tickets (needs a key, sign-outs and the heartbeat)
admkeys.seam.switch.econ: Committed PAT moves to the hub
admkeys.seam.switch.erasure: Account deletions and “forget me” to the hub
admkeys.seam.switch.export: Chat hub data in “Download my data” (exports wait for the hub while on)
admkeys.seam.switch.identity: Accounts and their chat links to the hub
admkeys.seam.switch.looks: Looks (cosmetics, flair, text style) to the hub, and the hub's looks lookups
admkeys.seam.s1_state: {skipped} link(s) left out (they'd fail the hub's rules) · {calls} looks lookup(s), {items} look(s) sent, {missing} unknown
admkeys.seam.inbound_missing: no hub key configured (snapshots and rewind are off)
admkeys.seam.inbound_env: the hub key's id doesn't match this site's environment
admkeys.seam.inbound_public: {n} reached through the public site - add the nginx /internal/ rule (deploy/README.md)
admkeys.seam.hidden_state: {n} hidden: {left} left out of quotes and the hub, {anon} shown there as “someone”
admkeys.seam.hidden_kinds: why: {bridge} !bridge hide, {incognito} incognito, {unknown} not known (an older Pepe's list - left out)
admkeys.seam.hidden_absent: {n} missing from one of an older Pepe's lists (a second list in a row without them un-hides them)
admkeys.seam.hidden_full: full: new hashes are not kept
admkeys.seam.hidden_held: {n} held for an owner (they stay hidden until you decide below)
admkeys.seam.hidden_untimed: {n} lists without a usable time (they only add)
admkeys.seam.hidden_back: {n} lists came out of order (Pepe's clock went back, or a late post) - compared with nothing
admkeys.seam.hidden_late: {n} un-hides ignored as a late post (older than a hide that had just arrived)
admkeys.seam.hidden_clock_ahead: Pepe's clock is {n} s ahead of the site's (nothing here depends on it)
admkeys.seam.hidden_clock_behind: Pepe's clock is {n} s behind the site's (nothing here depends on it)
admkeys.seam.held_help: These people dropped off Pepe's hidden list in a way that can also mean he lost track of them: too many at once, missing after he restarted (a !bridge show just before a restart looks exactly like his state file failing to load), or hidden before Pepe said why and in neither of his lists now. They stay hidden until you decide. The website never knows who they are - only how many - so be careful: approving a batch that really was Pepe losing track (after a crash or a restore, say) shows ALL of them by name again in quotes, tips, mentions and on the chat hub, and nobody can tell you who they were. Only approve a batch when you know why it formed (Check a chat login below to see whether it is held); keep it hidden otherwise. Someone who is also incognito stays shown as “someone” after you approve. A held member can also fix it themselves in a bridged room: !bridge hide, then a few seconds later !bridge show.
admkeys.seam.held_mass: {n} dropped off one list at once ({at})
admkeys.seam.held_legacy: {n} hidden before Pepe said why, and in neither of his lists now ({at})
admkeys.seam.held_order: {n} missing from a list that came out of order ({at})
admkeys.seam.held_other: ({n} of them stay hidden another way)
admkeys.seam.hidden_pepe_kinded: Pepe says why each person is hidden, and sends explicit hide / show events
admkeys.seam.hidden_pepe_explicit: Pepe sends explicit hide / show events (but not why someone is hidden: his list counts as not known)
admkeys.seam.hidden_pepe_older: an older Pepe: someone is un-hidden when two of his lists in a row in the same run drop them
admkeys.seam.unhide_help: Pepe's hidden set is sticky: a short or empty list from Pepe never un-hides anyone, and the set is kept on disk whatever the switches say. It keeps why each person is hidden: !bridge hide leaves their lines out, incognito shows them as “someone” (their words stay), and an older Pepe's list that doesn't say which leaves them out. Each kind goes only on its own un-hide: Pepe's “shown” event for that kind, his incognito-off report (incognito only), or on an older Pepe two of his lists in a row in the same run that drop them. Drops that can also mean Pepe lost track of people wait for you in the list above. Someone can still stay hidden after a change the site couldn't see: Check their chat login, then un-hide that kind (or all) here (for a hash, put # in front of its 20 characters). Looking someone up is logged too. If Pepe still hides them, his next sync hides them again.
admroles.title: Roles & permissions
admroles.lede: Who can drive Pepe, and how much. Any site admin can look. Changes follow Pepe's own !role and !perm rules, decided by your Pepe role (through your linked Camfrog login), reach Pepe on his next sync (about a minute) and are written to the admin audit log.
admroles.you_owner: You are an owner in Pepe's roles ({login}): you can change anything here.
admroles.you_admin: You are an admin in Pepe's roles ({login}): you can hand out staff, assistant and trusted, and change permissions within an admin's reach. Only owners set owner-only things or change what an owner set.
admroles.you_none: Your account has no Pepe admin or owner role (linked Camfrog login: {login}), so you can look but not change anything.
admroles.sync_ok: Pepe last synced his permission table {when}.
admroles.sync_never: Pepe hasn't synced his permission table yet. The command and moderation tables appear after his first sync (every minute, from Pepe 1.99aci on). Role holders already work.
admroles.not_synced_short: Waiting for Pepe's first sync of his permission table.
admroles.locked_by_owner: An owner set this - only an owner can change it.
admroles.pending.h: Owner changes waiting for an owner
admroles.pending.help: Pepe's role sync can't make or remove an owner on its own. When a chat !role asks for that, the change waits here and Pepe keeps the role the website has. An existing owner confirms it with their account password, or rejects it.
admroles.pending.pw: Your account password (needed to confirm or reject)
admroles.holders.help: Owners can change anything. Admins hand out staff, assistant and trusted, and only to people below admin. Pepe always keeps an owner. Site classes follow these roles for linked accounts (owner and admin = Admin).
admroles.cmds.help: Every command has two settings: can use is the lowest role that may run it at all, and admin powers is the lowest role that counts as an admin inside it. Listed: the commands Pepe has defaults for, the owner-only and room-role commands, the moderation commands, and any command someone changed.
admroles.cmds.legend: In each role's column, the first mark is can use and the second is admin powers (✅ yes, ❌ no).
admroles.cmds.lock_owner: Owners only: points, the economy, Pepe's process and data. Never grantable.
admroles.cmds.lock_room: Camfrog room roles: Pepe admins and owners (and pad owners in their own room). Never staff, assistants or trusted.
admroles.cmds.add_help: Any other Pepe command starts at the defaults (admin powers: admin, can use: everyone). Pick what to change.
admroles.targets.help: Staff and assistants can moderate through Pepe with these commands - but only on people below the role shown. Nobody means the command isn't theirs. Admins and owners aren't covered by these rules.
admroles.targets.admin_limits: Staff can act on people below admin at most, assistants on people below staff (or anyone). Only an owner chooses Anyone (that includes Pepe's admins and owners) or widens a room-role command (🔒) past its default.
admroles.targets.ceiling_staff: On !friend and !mod, staff can't change the room role of anyone above a room {cf}.
admroles.targets.ceiling_assistant: On !friend and !mod, assistants can't change the room role of anyone above a room {cf}.
admroles.notes.real_role: A person's real role decides protections (who can't be votekicked, timed out or fined by automod) and who runs paid commands for free. A command's admin powers never make someone an admin anywhere else.
admroles.notes.pad_owners: Pad owners have their own rules on their own pad (room moderation in their own room, never on Pepe's admins or owners). This page doesn't change them.
admroles.notes.sync: Changes made here reach Pepe on his next sync, and changes made in chat show up here the same way. When both change the same setting, the newer change wins.
admroles.website.help: The website's own permissions: who can use each admin page and staff power on PATV. Each row has a minimum class - Admin, Staff or Assistant - and that class and every class above it have it. Pepe's owners and admins change them here, by their Pepe role like the tables above: an admin never changes a row an owner set, and 🔒 rows never change. Nothing here ever reaches members.
admroles.website.legend: ✅ = that class has it. A change applies at once and is written to the admin audit log.
admroles.website.readonly: You can look; changes are for Pepe's owners and admins.

acctdel.title: Delete your account
acctdel.lead: Deleting is permanent after a {days}-day grace period. Read what happens first.
acctdel.what.profile: Your profile, email, connections (Twitch, Discord, Google, Apple, Plex, Telegram, wallets), sign-ins, notices, settings, badges and cosmetics are removed.
acctdel.what.posts: Posts and comments someone replied to stay, shown as “Deleted user”, so the conversation still makes sense. Everything else you posted is deleted.
acctdel.what.dms: The messages you sent are deleted, and you leave every conversation.
acctdel.what.pat: PAT is points, not money. Your remaining balance (and the PAT in stashes only you use) goes to the PAT Routing destination - by default the Federal Reserve - so nothing vanishes from the economy.
acctdel.what.camfrog: Your Camfrog name is released, and Pepe forgets what he remembered about it.
acctdel.what.kept: Records we have to keep - transactions, purchases, donations, moderation and safety reports - stay, under an anonymous name.
acctdel.what.chat: What you said in pads' chat stays in their history - under your Camfrog name, or as a former member for lines you sent from the website - unless you tick Also hide my past public chat lines below.
acctdel.what.grace: For {days} days nothing happens yet: every device is signed out, and signing in again (any way) cancels the deletion.
acctdel.elevated: Admin, staff and moderator accounts can't delete themselves here. Ask another admin to delete it from the admin panel.
acctdel.block_lede: Some things involve other people or points still in play. Close or finish them, then come back.
acctdel.password_or_fresh: No password? Sign out and sign back in any way you like (Google, Apple, Plex, Telegram, Twitch, Discord, or a !signin chat link) - for 10 minutes after that you don't need one.
acctdel.fresh_needed: Your account has no password. Sign out, sign back in (Google, Apple, Plex, Telegram, Twitch, Discord or a !signin chat link), and come back here within 10 minutes.
acctdel.fresh_ok: You signed in a moment ago, so no password is needed.
acctdel.hide_lines: Also hide my past public chat lines
acctdel.hide_lines_meta: When the account is deleted, your lines in pads' chat history (your linked Camfrog name and the ones you sent from the website) are left out for everyone, for good. Copies people already downloaded or quoted aren't reached.
acctdel.what.hub: Messages you sent in PATV chat stay in their rooms, shown as a former member's - unless you tick Also remove my public messages below.
acctdel.remove_public_meta: When the account is deleted, the words of your public messages are deleted too: what you sent in PATV chat, and the lines you sent from the website in pads' chat history (also those shown under your linked Camfrog name). A message under a report is kept until 30 days after the report is decided (90 days at most while it isn't), one under a legal hold until the hold ends, and deleted then. You can ask for this once a day. Not reached: your lines from Camfrog and the ones you sent while incognito with a linked Camfrog name (Also hide my past public chat lines leaves those out), and copies already sent to Camfrog or downloaded.
acctdel.remove_public_wait: You asked for this less than a day ago, so you can ask again after {when} (UTC).

premium.routes.heading: Where your PAT goes
premium.routes.note: Nothing is burned. The pad-vault share goes to Fort Knox when the pad's owner pays for their own pad (you never feed your own vault) or when the pad can't have a vault. Pad vaults and Fort Knox are part of {!link}.
premium.rules.heading: How it works
premium.rules.time: Every payment adds time: a period is {days} days, a chip-in adds its share of a period. You can pay up to about a year ahead.
premium.rules.renewing: Renewing: tick 🔁 and the daily run takes one period from your balance when it's due. For a pad, one person is the renewer (the owner can always take it over).

premium.rules.grace.one: Grace: if the renewal can't be paid, the perks stay on for {count} day while anyone tops it up. Then it lapses: the perks switch off and the renewer is cleared. Nothing is lost - the looks come back when it's renewed.
premium.rules.grace.other: Grace: if the renewal can't be paid, the perks stay on for {count} days while anyone tops it up. Then it lapses: the perks switch off and the renewer is cleared. Nothing is lost - the looks come back when it's renewed.

premium.rules.gifts: Gifts and chip-ins tell the pad's owner (or the person you gifted) in their notices - with your name, unless you tick 🕶 Send anonymously. All payments are final - no refunds.
premium.rules.admins: Site admins' own accounts and pads have both tiers comped.

gtf.lede: Roll a character, pull heists to get rich, put bounties on rivals, join a gang and fight for turf. A new map every season. It all runs in chat with Pepe, and it all pays in PAT.
gtf.me.heading: YOUR CHARACTER
gtf.me.none: No sheet linked yet. Type {!cmd} in chat with Pepe to roll one.
gtf.me.link_hint: Link your chat account (Settings → Account → Connections) so your sheet shows up here.
gtf.me.anon: Type {!cmd} in chat with Pepe to roll a character. Sign in to see your sheet here.
gtf.heists.title: Heists
gtf.heists.body: Your character sheet (six stats, a class, gear) decides every roll. Crew up, survive the rounds to bank loot, bail or go for the vault door. Store, casino, convoy and Fort Knox (the bank job).
gtf.turf.title: Turf Wars
gtf.turf.body: Every district on this season's map runs a business that earns its owner PAT. Claim open turf, raid rivals, fortify what you hold, and climb the season score. The map changes each season.
gtf.gangs.title: Gangs
gtf.gangs.body: Gangs share a treasury, wages and heat. A gang takes turf together, defends it together, and splits what it earns. Too much heat brings the police.
gtf.bounties.title: Bounties
gtf.bounties.body: Put PAT on a job: anyone can chip in, hunters claim it, and the poster pays whoever pulled it off. The pot sits in escrow until then.
gtf.start.heading: START HERE
gtf.start.foot: Type these in chat with Pepe. {!cmd} posts these links in chat.
gtf.mm.heading: HEIST MINIMAP
gtf.mm.sub: Live from Pepe: which targets are open, which are cooling down, how fat each vault is, and the job running right now.
gtf.mm.radar: Radar: one blip per target, green open, amber cooling down, red being hit
gtf.live.title: Live heist
gtf.live.lede: The heist running right now, as Pepe shows it on stream: the crew, every roll, the vault door and who got away with what.

gtf.mm.live_lobby: {job}: the crew is forming in {room}, {n} in so far. Type {!cmd} to get in.
gtf.lb.title: GTF leaderboards
gtf.lb.lead: Who stole the most, who got deepest into the vault, who never gets pinched, and who runs the fights. Pepe keeps score in chat ({!cmd} shows the top 3); the full boards live here.
gtf.lb.none: The boards fill in as soon as Pepe reports in. Type {!cmd} in chat with Pepe to roll a character and get on them.
gtf.lb.d.loot: Total points stolen across every heist.
gtf.lb.d.deep: The furthest round reached on any job, then vault cracks.
gtf.lb.d.survive: Heists walked away from without getting pinched, as a share of all heists. At least {n} heists to qualify.
gtf.lb.d.arena: Arena crowns won: the last one standing takes the pot.
gtf.lb.d.brawl: Wins minus losses, then net points won.
gtf.lb.d.duel: Net points won in dice duels.
gtf.lb.gangs: Crews ranked by rep, with their treasuries and war records.
gtf.lb.privacy: Players who are {!cmd}, or who keep Grand Theft Frogger off their public profile, show as “someone” ({!link}).

gtf.sheet.title: Heist sheet
gtf.sheet.done_t: Jobs pulled off (reached the last rounds)
gtf.sheet.mirror: GTF records live in Pepe right now, so this is his copy. It updates a few seconds after anything changes.
gtf.sheet.missing: {name} hasn't rolled a heist sheet yet. Type {!cmd} in chat with Pepe to roll one (the first is free).
gtf.sheet.adv_t: {cls} advantage: roll twice on this stat's checks and keep the better roll
gtf.sheet.stats_note: Each heist round tests one stat: roll 1d20 plus its modifier. As a {cls} you roll with advantage on your best stat.
gtf.sheet.points: You have {n} unspent stat point(s): {!cmd} in chat.
gtf.sheet.empty: Nothing in the bag yet. Gear up with {!cmd} in chat, or pull off a store heist and check the back room.
gtf.sheet.confirm_sheet_p: All six stats are rolled again (4d6, drop the lowest), so your class can change. Spent stat points and used Kingpin's Rings come back to you, and your gear, items and avatar stay. It costs {price} PAT, the same as !sheet regen in chat.
gtf.sheet.confirm_avatar_p: You get a brand-new pixel frog. Your equipped cosmetics stay on. It costs {price} PAT, the same as !avatar regen in chat.
gtf.sheet.queued: Sent to Pepe. He's rolling it now…
gtf.sheet.fail: That didn't work, and nothing was charged.
gtf.sheet.net: Network error. Try again: the same click is never charged twice.

rank.sup.heading: Where all the PAT is
rank.sup.note: The games never make or destroy PAT — it moves between wallets and these pools. New PAT is only made by the Federal Reserve, and every mint is logged. The only PAT ever destroyed is what the Reserve holds above its ceiling (the 🔥 burn reserve).

pad.rules.plus_hard: Plus the site's hard limits from {!link} — no doxxing, threats, illegal content and the like — which hold in every pad.
pad.rules.site_wide: No pad rules of its own, so the site-wide guidelines apply: be decent, swear if you like, tag NSFW, report rather than retaliate. The hard limits:

pad.addr.title: 🔗 Address & platform
pad.addr.what: Where your pad lives on the site, and what it's connected to.
pad.addr.intro: Your pad is at publicaccess.tv/p/{slug}. Pick a new one and every old link keeps working: they redirect to the new address, tabs and anchors included. Posts, followers, stories, the stage and the pad vault stay with the pad.
pad.addr.recent: You changed it recently. Next change possible on {date} (once every {days} days; a site admin can change it sooner).
pad.addr.rule: {min}-{max} characters: letters, digits and single hyphens.
pad.addr.once_every: You can change it once every {days} days.
pad.conn.intro: This pad is a {!badge}. Connect it to where your people already hang out: a Camfrog room (its live chat and Pepe's room features) or a Twitch channel (your stream on the pad). One platform at a time; disconnecting keeps the feed, followers, settings and pad vault.
pad.conn.house: House pads are run by the site.
pad.conn.want_pepe: I'd like Pepe in my room
pad.conn.plus_in: 💎 This pad has Prime Time Plus: Pepe is in the room and stays while it lasts.
pad.conn.plus_out: This pad's Prime Time Plus has ended, so Pepe left the room and it doesn't show live here. The connection, owner, pad vault and royalties stay. {!link} to bring Pepe back.
pad.conn.plus_joins: 💎 With Prime Time Plus, Pepe joins the room on his own to see the code, and stays once it's connected.
pad.conn.pepe_in: Pepe is in the room now
pad.conn.cf_disc_what: The pad goes back to being a site pad with its feed, followers, stories, settings, address and pad vault. What belongs to the Camfrog room stays with the room: its live chat history, room stats and royalties earned there. If Pepe is in the room it gets a new, unowned pad. stage.lede: Every pad has a stage. Stream to it from OBS or your browser, or put a YouTube / Twitch video on it. Viewers flip between the pad's streams and Pepe's. The pad owner can feature one stream as the pad's main one, and the front page shows the liveliest pad — earned, never bought.
stage.step1: Pick a pad and a slot: go on now, book a time (up to {days} days ahead), or join the queue when every slot is taken.
stage.step2: Stream with the key (OBS, Streamlabs…), straight from this page with your camera or screen, or paste a YouTube / Twitch link.
stage.step3: Featured = the pad's main stream, picked by the pad owner (free). The front page shows the liveliest pad: chat, mic, posts, comments, viewers and people decide. Anyone can 🚀 boost a pad from its page — it can tip a close race, it can't carry a quiet pad.
stage.step4: Slots are free unless the pad's owner sets a price. A slot price is per live minute: PAT is held up front, you pay only for the minutes you're live and the rest comes straight back. Half of what you pay goes to the pad vault, half to Fort Knox.
stage.owners_note: Pad owners set how many slots their pad has, can feature, cut or ban, and may require approval for bookings. Admins can cut any slot (unused PAT is refunded). Keep it within the site rules.
stage.closed: Stage booking is closed right now.
stage.cap_allow: Viewers may snap and clip my stream (saved to the pad's story)
stage.cap_nsfw: My stream is NSFW (18+) - snaps and clips of it are marked NSFW
stage.obs_how: In OBS: Settings → Stream → Service: Custom, then paste these. Start streaming and you're on the stage within a few seconds.
stage.key_note: Your key works only for this slot and stops working when it ends. Don't share it.
stage.recommended: Recommended: 1280×720 or 1920×1080, 30 fps, x264 2500–4500 kbps, keyframe interval 2 s, AAC 128 kbps.
stage.whip_how: In OBS: Settings → Stream → Service: WHIP, then paste these. Viewers who pick ⚡ Low latency see you about a second behind.
stage.bearer_val: Your stream key (above) - the same key
stage.whip_note: Use RTMP or WHIP, not both at once. WHIP settings: x264 (or a hardware H.264 encoder), Opus audio (OBS picks it), keyframe interval 1–2 s, B-frames off.
stage.keep_open: Keep this tab open while you're live. Stopping the browser stream doesn't end your slot - use End my slot for that (or it ends by itself after {n} minutes off air).
stage.rtc_intro: Go live from your browser (camera / screen) — ultra-low latency. Sent over WebRTC: viewers who pick ⚡ Low latency see you about a second behind, everyone else gets the normal stream.
stage.keep_open_rtc: Keep this tab open while you're live. Stop doesn't end your slot - use End my slot for that.
stage.embed_note: Your video is on the stage. It stays on until your time is up or you end the slot.
stage.rs_what: PATV re-sends your stage stream to your own Twitch channel while you're live - no second upload from your computer. Works for OBS (RTMP) and browser streams; it's copied as-is, so Twitch's limits apply (H.264 + AAC, keyframes every 2 s, up to about 6000 kbps). Your key is stored encrypted and never shown again.

economy.h1: Where PAT comes from, and where it goes
economy.lead: PAT is the points currency of PATV: one balance for the website, the pads' chat rooms and Discord. Spending never destroys it: it moves into pools that pay it back out as prizes, loot and rewards. These are the live numbers.
economy.tile.fed_d: the only place PAT is made
economy.live_note: Live from Pepe's latest report (every few minutes).
economy.not_reported: Pepe hasn't reported these numbers yet.
economy.loop.s1_d: New PAT is only ever made here, under written rules, and every mint is on the public record: the floor top-up, organic issuance (when it's switched on), admin mints and the rare loan mint. Donations are the one mint that lands in a wallet: the donor's.
economy.loop.s3_d: Rewards, prizes, heist loot, tips and staking profits land in players' wallets. Rewards come from the incentive budget, never straight from the Fed.
economy.loop.s4_d: Only the Fed's excess above its ceiling is burned. No wallet, stash or game pool ever is.
economy.loop.back: ↺ Spending goes back to the pools: spins, tickets, fees and room spends refill the House, the vaults and the Fed. Every Monday the House, the Bank and the Market maker settle their profit: 20% to stakers, up to half of the rest to the Fed, and the remainder to the incentive budget.
economy.band.now_lo: The Federal Reserve is below its floor right now, so it tops itself up with new PAT each day until it is back in the band.
economy.band.now_ok: The Federal Reserve is inside its band right now: nothing is being minted and nothing is being burned.
economy.band.now_hi: The Federal Reserve is above its ceiling right now: the excess is released and burned at the next daily tick.
economy.band.lo: A capped daily mint (at most 5M a day) refills it, so the weekly rewards and the pools' safety net never run dry.
economy.band.ok: No floor mint and no burn. The Fed fills the pools from what it holds; organic issuance, when it's switched on, can top it up toward the ceiling.
economy.band.hi: The excess leaves circulation: it is burned, so supply can't run away.
economy.band.none: The Fed's floor and ceiling haven't been reported yet.
economy.sits.aria: The PAT supply split by layer
economy.sits.link: the supply tab on the leaderboard
economy.ib.lead: Rewards are paid from this budget, not printed. It holds {n} PAT; each group has a weekly allowance, and a reward over it waits in line until the budget refills.
economy.ib.foot: It refills every Monday from the protocol's profit, with the Fed guaranteeing the weekly target.
economy.ib.foot_v3: Every Monday it gets its share of the protocol's profit, and the Fed tops it up to the weekly target of {target} PAT. Every faucet in the game is paid from it.
economy.ib.off: Not switched on yet: rewards are still paid the way they are today.
economy.v.house_d: the casino bankroll: pays the wheel and the tables
economy.v.foot: Heist vaults pay out like a dividend: loot comes out of them, never out of thin air. The incentive budget keeps each at 2M or more, and anything above its cap flows back to the budget. The admins can switch the heist faucet on and off. Stake in the House, the Bank or the Market maker on {!link}.

economy.map.h: How PAT is made, moves and comes back
economy.map.lead: The whole economy in one picture, as it runs today. Dashed items are coming soon.
economy.map.src_floor: Floor top-up if the Fed ends a day below its floor (at most 5M a day)
economy.map.src_issue: Organic issuance, a steady trickle that grows when the rooms are busy (off for now)
economy.map.src_admin: Admin mints, into the Fed only, each with a written reason
economy.map.src_loan: Loan mints, only if the Fed is ever short for a loan
economy.map.src_note: Every mint is logged, and the daily supply history is public: {!link}.
economy.map.fed_d: Keeps itself between a floor of {floor} and a ceiling of {ceiling} PAT. It never pays a wallet: its job is to keep the pools stocked.
economy.map.burn_d: Anything above the {ceiling} ceiling is destroyed at the daily tick. Nothing else is ever burned.
economy.map.to_ib: every Monday: tops it up to {target} for the week
economy.map.ib_d: Pays every faucet, each kind within its weekly allowance. A reward over its allowance waits in line.
economy.map.f_grants: Welcome PAT, level-ups, achievements, connect bonuses and codes
economy.map.f_rooms: Room games (raffle, top mic, pictionary) and pad owner royalties
economy.map.f_heist: Heist vault floors: Fort Knox and the Casino vault kept at 2M or more
economy.map.f_launch: Launch grants that seed new pads' vaults
economy.map.f_activity: Activity rewards for people who chat and get on the mic
economy.map.f_topup: Activity top-ups: shared by each pad's real activity, never more than the pad pays out
economy.map.f_scaled: A weekly budget that grows with verified activity
economy.map.to_tr: flash liquidity, loans and grants when they run short
economy.map.tr_d: The working vaults: the casino bankroll, player loans and prediction markets. You can stake in them and share their profit.
economy.map.to_hv: heist buy-ins and half of every room spend
economy.map.hv_h: 🥷 Fort Knox · Casino vault · 💰 pad vaults
economy.map.hv_d: The heist vaults pay out heist loot. Pad vaults fill up with the other half of what's spent in each pad.
economy.map.pl_d: Your wallet, your stashes and your stakes. Tips go straight from one player to another.
economy.map.don: 💖 Donations: every $1 adds {rate} PAT to the donor's wallet, plus {pct}% on top for the incentive budget ({!link}).
economy.map.r.casino: Casino games (wheel, blackjack, hold'em, bingo) and the wager fee
economy.map.r.cmds: Paid commands in a room (say, ask, roast, look, clips, voices, music)
economy.map.r.cmds_to: {fk}% Fort Knox · {rv}% that pad's vault · {own}% the pad's owner
economy.map.r.room: Other spending in a room: gear, cosmetics, boosts, stage slots, gifts
economy.map.r.premium: Prime Time · Season Pass and sticker packs
economy.map.r.premium_to: 50% Fort Knox · 50% the pad's vault · Fort Knox
economy.map.r.heist_to: the Casino vault (casino job) · Fort Knox (bank and store jobs)
economy.map.r.fines: Fines, the bounty fee and the shop fee
economy.map.r.tips_to: the person you tip, no fee
economy.map.r_note: Spending in your own pad goes all to Fort Knox. Until room turf wars arrive, a small slice of blackjack and hold'em and part of the fight rake still go to the old turf businesses.
economy.map.b_monday: Monday settlement: the House, the Bank and the Market maker each keep a target bankroll. Profit above it first repays any Fed loan, then 20% goes to stakers (up to 25% a year), then half of the rest goes to the Fed while it's below its ceiling, and everything else goes to the incentive budget.
economy.map.b_heist: Heist vault overflow: above their caps ({fk} and {cv}, 60% and 40% of the weekly budget), Fort Knox and the Casino vault send the extra back to the incentive budget.
economy.map.b_fed: Fees for the Fed: fines and fees refill the Federal Reserve, so the weekly top-up needs less new PAT.
economy.map.b_rooms: Pad vault payouts: a small daily payout to each pad's owner, streamers, regulars and room games, paid only from what the pad really earned.
economy.stk.grow_ceil: Your share of the vault's earnings compounds inside the price, up to the daily APR ceiling ({ceil}% a year: growth above it goes to the protocol; losses are not capped).
economy.stk.grow_free: Your share of the vault's earnings compounds inside the price in full: there's no daily APR ceiling, so the price carries the vault's whole growth and its whole losses (a big House payout, like the Monday Pepeball draw, lowers it too).
economy.stk.grow_any: Your share of the vault's earnings compounds inside the price.
economy.stk.grow_payout: Separately, the weekly staking payout is paid into your stash's balance.
economy.stk.fig_payout: The weekly payout lands in your stash.
economy.stk.limit_all: Stakers can own at most {p} of any vault (Auto deposits included), so the protocol always keeps skin in the game.
economy.stk.limit_direct: A direct stake is cut back, and the rest refunded, once stakers would own more than {p} of a vault. Auto deposits don't check that limit yet, so stakers can own more of a vault through Auto{!own}.
economy.stk.weekly: The weekly settlement: every Monday each vault's surplus is shared out: what the protocol's own shares in the vault are worth above what the protocol put in, at most the vault's value above its target size (the House: 15M; the Bank: 2M or twice its busiest lending; the Market maker: 1M or 1.5× its market seeds) and its free cash. It first repays any Fed loan, then stakers get {share}%, and the rest goes half to the Federal Reserve (while it's below its ceiling) and half to the {!inc}. Stakers' own shares already carry their part of the vault's growth in the price, so this payout is extra: it's {share}% of the protocol's part, not of everything the vault earned. It lands in the stash's balance; it doesn't change anyone's shares.
economy.stk.weighted: The stakers' {share}% is shared by PAT-days: what each stash had staked times the days it held it that week, so a stake made just before Monday earns almost nothing, and a stash that held all week gets its full part even if it unstaked before Monday.
economy.stk.snapshot: The stakers' {share}% is split by what each stash has staked when the week settles.
economy.stk.ceil_on: Daily APR ceiling: at each daily cut-off, stakers' share-price growth above {ceil}% a year {!cfg} moves to the protocol (its shares grow instead). Losses are not capped: a losing day lowers stakers' value in full, and they recover with the vault until it's back at its previous high.
economy.stk.ceil_cushion: On a losing day the protocol first gives stakers back up to what it kept from them over the last {days} days.
economy.stk.ceil_off: No daily APR ceiling {!cfg}: stakers keep a vault's full share-price growth and carry its full losses, the House's Monday draws included.
economy.stk.cap_on: Weekly payout cap: stakers' share of a week is capped at {cap}% a year on their stake {!cfg}; anything above it rejoins the rest of the surplus.
economy.stk.cap_off: No weekly payout cap {!cfg}: stakers get their full {share}% every week that's fully time-weighted. A week that isn't (the first week of the time-weighting, or one it couldn't cover) is still held to 25% a year on their stake.

markets.title: Prediction Markets
markets.lead: Prices are the crowd's odds. Buy shares in an outcome, sell any time while trading is open, and every winning share pays 1 PAT.
markets.empty_live_sub: Ask a question the room can trade on.
markets.auto.by.sports: Settled from the official final score on ESPN's scoreboard (no guessing). Postponed or cancelled = void, every stake back.
markets.auto.by.price: Settled from exchange price data at the resolution time.
markets.auto.by.ai: Settled by Pepe's AI judge from news reports, using the criteria above. Anyone in it can dispute his call.
markets.auto.note: Pepe opened this one himself about a real-world event. Betting closes before the event starts. PAT are points with no cash value.
automkt.feed.intro: Pepe opened these himself. He judges them from the data (final scores, prices) or the news. PAT only: points with no cash value.
automkt.feed.foot: Trade or bet on /markets, or with !market / !pool in chat.
automkt.adm.trending: Trending (Polymarket topics as ideas, off by default)
automkt.adm.trending_help: Trending: Pepe reads the busiest topics from Polymarket's public data and uses them as ideas only - the automkt model writes its own question, criteria, resolve date and an official source (never a prediction-market site). Anything too close to their wording, or about politics, war, people's health, minors, private people or adult topics, is thrown away. Trending ones wait for review like news ones.
automkt.adm.polls: Opinion ideas can become a room poll (one at a time)
automkt.adm.dedupe_help: Never a market AND a pool or poll on the same topic: every idea is checked against all live markets, pools and the running poll, and against the topics of the last 30 days. The type follows the question (yes/no = market, one winner of several = pool, opinion = poll) and is mixed where more than one fits.
automkt.adm.trending_state: Trending: {n} topics cached ({at}), refreshed every {h} h

market.rs.sub: It was first settled {from}. Taken back: {!back}{!funder}. Paid: {!paid}{!left}.
market.buy_est0: Each share pays 1 PAT if its outcome wins. Sell any time before trading closes.
js.market.est: ≈ {n} {opt} shares at {px} PAT each. They pay {n} PAT (+{gain}) if {opt} wins.
market.signin: Sign in to trade here, or in chat: {cmd}
market.j.void_note: Void: trading fees are kept, the Market maker takes back its seed first, and holders split what's left — up to what they put in.
market.j.only: Only the judge ({!who}) or an admin sees this. It pays out at once and can't be undone.
market.p.settled: Settled {result}: {result} shares paid 1 PAT each; {!others} shares are worth 0.
market.p.voided: Voided: trading fees are kept, holders got back what they put in (net of the 2% fee){!scaled}.
market.p.note: Entry = what you paid per share, fee included. Value = shares × today's price. A sale returns a bit less, because your own sale moves the price and there's a 2% fee. If your outcome wins, each share pays 1 PAT.
market.pool.note: Your PAT goes into escrow until the judge settles. Winners split the losing side's pool minus 5%.
market.pool.signin: Sign in to bet here, or in chat: {cmd}
aij.head: Judged by Pepe
aij.pays_in: Pays out in {mins} min unless enough people dispute it.
aij.disputed: Pepe said {result}, but it was disputed — an admin will settle it.
aij.thinking: Pepe is looking it up right now…
aij.unsure_esc_sub: He's handed it to the admins to settle. Anyone in it can still ask him to look again.
aij.again_at: He'll look again at {!when} (in {left}). If he still can't tell after a few tries, the admins settle it.
aij.resettled: ⚖ Re-settled {to} by an admin ({by}): {reason} Pepe's ruling below was wrong.
aij.how_market: When trading closes, Pepe checks the evidence (exchange price data for price questions, the web, his chat records), proposes the result with his reasoning, and it pays out after a dispute window.
aij.how_pool: When betting closes, Pepe checks the evidence (exchange price data for price questions, the web, his chat records), proposes the result with his reasoning, and it pays out after a dispute window.
wagers.title: Wagers & Pools
wagers.h1: Put your PAT where your mouth is
wagers.lead: Bet PAT against a friend, or open a pool the whole room can bet on.
wagers.x_wager: You and your opponent each put up the same stake. The judge picks the winner, who takes the pot minus {fee}%. Your stake sits in escrow from the moment you offer it; if it isn't accepted it comes back.
wagers.x_pool: Anyone bets any amount on an option. When the judge settles it, the winners split the losing side's pot pro rata to their bets, minus {fee}%, and get their own stake back.

casino.lobby_tag: Blackjack and No-Limit Hold'em with your PAT. Play right here, or push a table to a pad's chat room so room players sit at the same felt. Every shuffle is provably fair.

casino.how1: Blackjack bets come straight from your balance and winnings go straight back. In Hold'em you buy in for chips (1 chip = 1 PAT) and your chips turn back into PAT when you stand up.
casino.how2: The host can push a table to a chat room Pepe serves, and even onto Pepe's stream. Room players and web players share the same seats and the same cards.
casino.how3: Each shuffle is fixed and its fingerprint published before anyone bets. After the round the secret seed is revealed, so you can rebuild the deck yourself on the round's fairness page.
casino.fair_how: Before each round the table publishes the SHA-256 commitment of a secret seed. The deck comes from that seed and the table's client seed; the seed is revealed afterwards, and each round's 🔐 page checks it in your browser.

td.title: Report intimate images shared without consent
td.h1: Remove intimate images shared without consent
td.sub: If an intimate picture or video of you - real or made with AI - is on PATV without your consent, we remove it within 48 hours of a valid request, together with identical copies we know of.
td.note: You don't need an account. The posts you list are hidden as soon as you send this, while we review it. Questions or anything else: {!email}.
td.minor: If the content shows someone under 18, also report it to the {!link} (NCMEC). Don't download or share it.
td.name: Your full name
td.email: Email we can reach you at
td.rel_auth: authorised to act for the person shown
td.urls: Link(s) to the content on PATV
td.urls_hint: One per line: the post's address, or the picture's own address.
td.desc: What it shows and anything else that helps us find it (optional)
td.good_faith: I believe in good faith that this content is an intimate image of me (or of the person I represent) shared without consent, and the information in this request is accurate.
td.done: Request received. We'll act on it within 48 hours. Your reference:
td.fine: This process follows the US TAKE IT DOWN Act. Misusing it can lead to your account being closed. See {!terms}.

owner.title: Owner panel · {pad}
owner.guide_lead: Own a pad with a Camfrog room? Here's everything Pepe lets you run yourself - in chat and on the website - and what stays with Pepe's admins. New to pads? Start with the pad owners guide.
owner.lead: Your room at a glance: the vault and how to top it up, your owner share and the daily payouts, Prime Time, the stage, and the Pepe settings that are yours to change. Each card says what it does and why. New to this? The pad owners guide shows what your pad can do.
owner.staff_view: You're seeing this as site staff. Changes you make here are sent as you and logged.
owner.vault_why: Half of what people spend in your pad - paid Pepe commands, songs, voices, heist gear, boosts, stage slots, gifts - lands in the pad vault; the other half goes to Fort Knox. It's the pad's own pool of PAT (points, not money): mic challenge prizes, the room games' prizes and the daily payouts to you, your streamers and your regulars come out of it. When you spend in your own pad it all goes to Fort Knox instead. The vault holds at most {cap} PAT, and anyone can donate to it from the pad page.
owner.topup_why: Put your own PAT in to fund prizes and payouts. It's exactly !padvault deposit: Pepe takes it from your linked Camfrog name, or from your PATV account if you haven't linked one. The minimum is {min} PAT, and deposits never count as the pad's income. A new launch pad gets its owner's deposits matched for a while.
owner.topup_link: Link your Camfrog name first: type !verify in a Camfrog room with Pepe. Deposits come from that name.
owner.topup_hint: You have {bal} PAT (as {login}). The vault can take {room} PAT more.
owner.topup_hint_web: You have {bal} PAT (from your PATV account). The vault can take {room} PAT more.
owner.vault_not_live: Pad vaults aren't open yet - top-ups start when they are.
owner.v_rate: Daily payout rate: {rate}% of the balance. Change it on the pad page (once a week; it applies from the next payout day).
owner.v_unavailable: The vault couldn't be loaded right now.
owner.roy_none: Royalties go to a pad's owner when it has one (a member, not the house). This pad doesn't earn owner royalties.
owner.roy_why: You earn a share of what people spend in your room: {stage}% of paid stage time and a cut of Pepe's paid commands, songs and voices (the shares are below). Your own spending doesn't count. Royalties are paid weekly from the Federal Reserve when the room was active on at least {days} days that week; unpaid ones expire after a few weeks.
owner.r_need_days: {n} more active day(s) this week and this week's royalties are paid.
owner.share_why: Every day your pad vault pays out up to {rate}% of its balance through the payout recipe. You get the owner share - {pct}% of that day's budget - when you were active on at least {days} of the last 7 days and the pad was active on at least {active} of them. Either place counts, and a day counts once: on the pad itself (you posting, commenting, streaming on its stage or moderating, and 3 or more members posting, commenting, voting or watching that day) or in a connected Camfrog room (you in the room, and the room bridged for an hour with 3 or more people). It's capped at {cap}% of the pad's average daily income over the last 7 days, so it grows with real activity: deposits and donations (yours or anyone's) and your own spending never raise it. House pads never pay an owner. PAT are points, not money.
owner.share_house: This is a house pad (Pepe's): it never pays an owner share. Its payout budget goes to the streamers, the regulars and the room games, and whatever isn't earned stays in the vault.
owner.share_none_yet: No payout day yet - the first one runs the morning after room payouts start.
owner.recipe_h: The payout recipe, day by day
owner.recipe_why: Each day's budget is split into fixed slices; each slice pays only what was earned and the rest stays in the vault for a busier day: owner {owner}%, the controlling gang {gang}%, streamers {streamers}% (by verified watch-minutes on your stage), regulars {people}% (people with real chat or mic time that day) and room games {games}% (the prize pool for the raffle, top mic of the hour and pictionary). Payouts of {convoy} PAT or more ride a 10-minute convoy that can be hit.
owner.rc_games_left: Room games today: {left} of {allow} PAT left for prizes.
owner.recipe_games_unpaid: What the owner, gang and streamer slices don't pay out on a day tops up the room-games prize pool until the next payout instead; prizes the games don't award still stay in the vault.
owner.roy_frozen: Royalties ended when room payouts started: what was still pending was paid out once and the royalty ledger is kept as history. You earned {paid} PAT in royalties in all.
owner.roy_until: Until room payouts start, royalties keep running as before.
owner.guide_earn_more: Your owner panel (/p/your-pad/owner) shows your share day by day, whether you qualified and why not, and the whole recipe for your pad. The PAT economy explains where the pad vault's PAT comes from.
owner.prime_why: Prime Time is the pad tier: {slots} extra stage slot(s), {badges} extra pad badge(s), low-latency streaming, and Pepe keeps your room's chat logs and recordings longer. Anyone can chip in to keep it on.
owner.prime_renews: Paid through {when}; it renews by itself.
owner.stage_why: Your pad's stage is where members stream. You pick how many slots it has, what they cost, whether bookings need your OK, and which stream is featured. Featuring is free for you.
owner.pepe_why: What Pepe is really doing in your room right now, straight from his last report, and the switches that are yours. A change waits for Pepe until his next report confirms it - usually a few seconds.
owner.pepe_unknown: Pepe hasn't reported this room yet
owner.pepe_unknown_help: He sends each pad's settings every couple of minutes while he's running. Check back shortly.
owner.pepe_stale: Pepe last reported these at {when} - he may be offline, so changes wait until he's back.
owner.set_snap_why: People can save a still of someone's cam (they pay the snap price).
owner.set_clip_why: People can record a few seconds of someone's cam to a link.
owner.set_challenge_why: Sing, laugh, beatbox... Pepe judges it and pays prizes from the pad vault.
owner.set_language_why: The language he writes and answers in here. Auto follows the room's chat; pick one to fix it. (How he hears the mic is the transcription setting below.)
owner.here_yes: Pepe is in the room right now.
owner.here_no: Pepe isn't in the room right now - changes still apply, and take effect when he's back.
owner.unreported: Pepe hasn't reported this one yet - it shows here after his next report.
owner.not_bridged: This room isn't connected to its pad page yet, so these switches only matter once it is (ask a Pepe admin).
owner.grp_basics_why: Cam snapshots and clips, mic challenges, the soundboard, the language Pepe chats in and the language he transcribes the mic in.
owner.grp_pepe_why: How much Pepe talks, who he welcomes back, and what people can make him do.
owner.grp_games_why: Which of Pepe's games can be played in your room. Turf wars and the casino backend stay with Pepe's admins.
owner.grp_mod_why: How Pepe keeps the room fair. Pepe admins set the limits these sit inside.
owner.grp_vibe_why: How Pepe reads the room - the same as !roomvibe in chat.
owner.set_soundboard_why: People can play soundboard clips here (chat !sb and the pad's 🔊 drawer). Off: Pepe politely refuses and charges nothing.
owner.set_greeter_why: Pepe says hello to people who stay a while - never the moment they walk in, and never to someone who already left.
owner.set_greet_new_why: New people who stay about a minute and a half get one relaxed welcome addressed to the room, shared with anyone else new - no questions, no call-outs.
owner.set_greet_regulars_why: People Pepe knows get a short personal hello after settling in - at most once every few hours, not after a quick rejoin, and not when the room is busy.
owner.set_greeter_note_why: Something Pepe keeps in mind when he greets people here (up to 160 characters). Empty = no note.
owner.set_chatty_why: Whether Pepe joins the conversation on his own, and how often.
owner.set_music_why: Pepe plays music in this room (and the DJ can run here).
owner.set_music_requests_why: People can request songs with !queue and !play.
owner.set_say_why: People can make Pepe say something on the mic (they pay the !say price).
owner.set_voices_why: People can pick which voice Pepe uses (-v), including paid per-use voices.
owner.set_mic_replies_why: People can ask for an answer on the mic instead of in chat (-mic).
owner.set_heist_why: Heists can be started in this room.
owner.set_pvp_why: Duels, brawls, the arena and showdowns between people.
owner.set_casino_why: Hold'em and blackjack in this room.
owner.set_global_unblock_why: Pepe undoes mic blocks other people make in your room a second later. Blocks Pepe makes himself (an admin's !blockmic, a vote, mic-hog policing) stay.
owner.set_michog_why: Pepe strikes and briefly blocks someone who keeps the mic from everyone else.
owner.set_strikes_why: How many strikes someone gets for mic hogging or abusing mod powers here before Pepe acts.
owner.set_votes_why: People can start votes to kick, mic-block, de-mod or time someone out (!votekick, !voteblock, !votemod, !timeout).
owner.set_say_mod_why: Checks what people have Pepe say out loud (!say, -mic reminders and relays, soundboard voice clips) before they pay. A refused line costs nothing, and they get a short reason. Off unless you pick a level.
owner.set_vibe_why: What kind of room this is to Pepe. Picking one locks the vibe.
owner.set_roasts_why: Whether Pepe roasts people unprompted, only when asked, or keeps it gentle.
owner.set_vibe_lock_why: Locked: Pepe keeps the room's vibe as it is instead of relearning it from the chat.
owner.grp_voice_why: Which voice Pepe speaks in by default in your room, captions of what he says on the mic, and event alerts.
owner.set_room_voice_why: The voice Pepe speaks in by default here: one of the voices you own (bought in the voice store, or your own approved clone) or Pepe's default. Someone's own -v voice on !say still wins, and nobody pays a per-use price for Pepe's lines in this voice.
owner.set_convo_why: When the room goes quiet with people still around, Pepe throws out a question or a topic - once per quiet spell.
owner.set_convo_quiet_why: How long the room has to be quiet before Pepe starts something.
owner.set_captions_why: When Pepe speaks on the mic, the room also gets a 🔊 caption of what he said.
owner.set_alerts_why: Pepe's alerts in your room: heists, games and drops starting here or in other rooms. Off = your room stays quiet about them.
owner.set_dj_talk_why: While the Auto-DJ plays in your room, Pepe says a short line between songs.
owner.voice_lost: You don't own this voice any more (or it's paused or was taken down), so Pepe speaks in his default voice ({name}) here until you pick another one.
owner.voice_by_admin: Pepe's admins set this room's voice. Picking one here replaces it.
owner.voice_persona: Pepe is wearing a persona with its own voice ({name}) right now - it wins over the room's voice until the admins take it off.
owner.voice_tts_off: Pepe's admins have his mic voice off in this room, so nobody hears it yet.
owner.voice_none: You don't own any voices yet - see the voice store.
owner.convo_llm_off: Pepe's admins have his chat model off right now, so starters wait until it's back.
owner.sm_light: Light - repeats, slurs aimed at people, threats, doxxing
owner.sm_standard: Standard - also any slur and insults aimed at people
owner.sb_master_off: Pepe's admins have the soundboard off everywhere right now, so it stays quiet until they switch it back on.
owner.michog_admin_off: Pepe's admins have anti-abuse off right now, so this only matters once they switch it back on.
owner.ps_paused: Pepe stays out (you sent him away)
owner.ps_banned: Pepe is banned from this room
owner.ps_banned_note: Banned by {by}. Pepe won't rejoin by himself until {when}; once the ban is lifted, press Join and he goes straight back in.
owner.ps_plus_only: Asking Pepe in or out of your room is a 💎 Prime Time Plus perk.
owner.ps_paused_note: You sent Pepe away, so Prime Time Plus and his recovery mode leave the room alone until you ask him back in.
owner.mod_why: Kick, ban, punish, block mics, time out (in this room only), fine and set room roles (moderator, admin, friend) in your own pad's Camfrog room - Pepe does it for you, as you. Pepe's admins and owners are off limits, every action asks first and goes in the mod log. The banned list shows who is banned, muted, mic-blocked or timed out, with undo; global unblock is in the 🐸 card above.
owner.mod_checking: Checking the room… This shows when the room is live and Pepe sees your linked Camfrog name as this pad's owner.
owner.mod_more: Typing works too, in your room: !kick, !ban, !unban, !punish, !blockmic, !timeout (up to 24 hours, this room only; !untimeout lifts it), !fine (up to 100,000 PAT), !mod, !admin, !friend, !unrole.
owner.bblk_why: Stop a website member from talking into this room from the pad page (chat lines, voice clips, !commands, the Pepe menu) - for a while or until you lift it. It only blocks their website relay: someone with a linked chat name keeps their normal Camfrog chat (use kick / ban / time-out for that). Pepe enforces it too, and it goes in the pad's event log.
owner.bblk_chat: In the room: !bridge block <name> [chat|commands|soundboard|voice|snapshots|livecams|clips] [30m|2h|7d] [reason], !bridge unblock <name> [feature], !bridge blocks. Without a feature it blocks everything. The name can be 🌐name (as the room sees it), their PATV username or their chat name.
owner.ml_why: Everything moderated in this room, newest first: kicks, bans, time-outs, mic blocks and role changes (by anyone, through Pepe or Camfrog), Pepe's automod strikes and fines, topic changes, and web bridge blocks. Only you, the room's mods and PATV admins can see it.
owner.bridge_why: What the pad's web page carries from the Camfrog room. Web visitors act as their own linked Camfrog name, with Pepe's rules.
owner.br_relay_why: Signed-in visitors can chat into the room and run Pepe commands (including the 🐸 Pepe menu).
owner.br_mic_why: Visitors can send short voice clips that Pepe plays on the mic.
owner.br_cams_why: Visitors can ask Pepe for a preview of an open cam.
owner.br_audio_why: The room's voice is streamed to the pad page.
owner.br_transcripts_why: What's said on the mic shows as text in the pad's chat.
owner.ro_h: Everything else Pepe runs here (Pepe admins change these)
owner.ro_why: Read-only for owners: these are switched by Pepe's admins. Ask one if you'd like something changed.
owner.can_h: What you can do with Pepe in your room
owner.can_why: Every owner power Pepe has, read straight from his code, with how to use it. Chat commands work when you type them in your room as your linked Camfrog name.
owner.admin_only_why: These are Pepe-admin settings. Owners can't change them in chat or on the website - ask a Pepe admin.
owner.generated: This list is generated from Pepe's code each release, so it's always what Pepe really allows.
owner.cap.web_vault_topup.title: Top up the pad vault
owner.cap.web_vault_topup.howto: The Top up form above deposits PAT from your linked Camfrog name (or your PATV account if you haven't linked one), through Pepe. A double click is one deposit.
owner.cap.web_vault_rate.title: Set the vault's payout rate
owner.cap.web_vault_rate.howto: On the pad page's vault card: how much of the vault is paid out each day once payouts start (2-15%, once a week).
owner.cap.web_pepe_settings.title: Change Pepe's room settings
owner.cap.web_pepe_settings.howto: Everything in the 🐸 Pepe card at the top of this page: snapshots, clips, the soundboard, games, moderation, the vibe and more.
owner.cap.web_bridge.title: Choose what the pad page carries
owner.cap.web_bridge.howto: Website chat and commands, push-to-talk, cam snapshots, room audio and transcripts.
owner.cap.web_stage_settings.title: Set up the stage
owner.cap.web_stage_settings.howto: Slot count, prices, approval for bookings and the stage's schedule.
owner.cap.web_stage_feature.title: Feature a stream
owner.cap.web_stage_feature.howto: Make a live slot the room's main stream (free for you), or stop featuring it.
owner.cap.web_stage_ban.title: Ban someone from your stage
owner.cap.web_stage_ban.howto: Stops a member from booking or queueing on your pad's stage.
owner.cap.web_pepe_feed.title: Pepe on your pad's feed
owner.cap.web_pepe_feed.howto: Whether Pepe answers and takes part in your pad's feed, and how often.
owner.cap.web_automod.title: Feed automod
owner.cap.web_automod.howto: How strictly Pepe's automod holds posts on your pad's feed (every call can be reversed).
owner.cap.web_golive.title: Announce stream starts
owner.cap.web_golive.howto: Pepe says it in your room when a stream on your pad goes live.
owner.cap.web_prime.title: Prime Time
owner.cap.web_prime.howto: The pad tier: extra stage slots and badges, low latency, longer log retention.
owner.cap.web_boost.title: Boost the pad
owner.cap.web_boost.howto: Push your pad up the front-page ranking for a while. Half goes to Fort Knox, half to the pad vault (all to Fort Knox when you boost your own pad).

owner.cap.stage.title: Run your room's stage
owner.cap.stage.howto: Type !stage in your Camfrog room to see what's on. Feature an open slot to make it the room's main stream (free), unfeature it, cut a slot (the unused PAT is refunded) or set how many user slots the room has. The same controls are on the Stage tab of your pad settings.
owner.cap.snap.title: Switch cam snapshots on or off
owner.cap.snap.howto: !snap lets people save a still of someone's cam (they pay the snap price). Type !snap off in your room to stop it there, or flip it on your owner page.
owner.cap.clip.title: Switch cam clips on or off
owner.cap.clip.howto: !clip records a few seconds of a cam to a link (and the website's 🎬 Clip). Switch it per room in chat or on your owner page.
owner.cap.language.title: Pick Pepe's language in your room
owner.cap.language.howto: Pepe follows the room's chat language by default (auto). Fix it to one language with !language es (or pick it on your owner page); !language auto goes back to following the chat.
owner.cap.challenge_switch.title: Switch mic challenges on or off
owner.cap.challenge_switch.howto: Mic challenges (sing, laugh, beatbox...) are judged by Pepe and paid from your pad vault. Turn them off in your room with !challenge off, or on your owner page.
owner.cap.challenge_run.title: Start, open and close mic challenges
owner.cap.challenge_run.howto: As the owner you can start a challenge for someone (!challenge sing @bob), open a round anyone can enter (!challenge open sing 2m), close the round or cancel a challenge.
owner.cap.pvp_cancel.title: Cancel someone's duel or brawl challenge
owner.cap.pvp_cancel.howto: Anyone can cancel their own challenge; in your room you can also cancel other people's open duel or brawl challenges (their stakes are refunded).
owner.cap.owner_match.title: Get your vault deposits matched (launch pads)
owner.cap.owner_match.howto: While your pad is new (a launch pad), what you deposit into its pad vault is matched from the launchpad budget up to its cap. Deposit with !padvault deposit <amount> or the Top up form on your owner page.
owner.cap.settings_web.title: Change your room's Pepe settings from the website
owner.cap.settings_web.howto: The 🐸 Pepe card at the top of your owner page shows what Pepe is really doing in your room right now (with when he last reported it) and changes it: snapshots, clips, mic challenges, the soundboard, Pepe's language and everything below. They're the same settings the chat commands and Pepe's admins use, so chat, the admin panel and the page always agree, and a switch shows 'waiting for Pepe' until he confirms it.
owner.cap.room_ctl.howto: 💎 Prime Time Plus pads: the owner page shows whether Pepe is in your room (or joining / recovering) and lets you ask him in, out or to rejoin - one action every 2 minutes. He stays out until you ask him back; he's in at most 5 rooms at a time and never leaves his own.
owner.cap.room_ctl.title: Bring Pepe in, send him out, or rejoin
owner.cap.room_fine.howto: Fine someone in your room up to 100,000 PAT at a time; it goes into the Federal Reserve and Pepe says it in the room.
owner.cap.room_fine.title: Fine someone
owner.cap.bridge_block.howto: Stop a website member from talking into your room from the pad page (chat lines, voice clips, !commands, the Pepe menu) - for a while or until you lift it. Someone with a linked chat name keeps their normal Camfrog chat. Name them as the room sees them (🌐name), by PATV username or by chat name; the same list is in Moderate your room on your owner page.
owner.cap.bridge_block.title: Block someone from talking into your room from the website
owner.cap.room_timeout.howto: In your room your !timeout works straight away (up to 24 hours) instead of starting a vote: Pepe mutes them in your pad's room only - not in other rooms, and their red list and roles aren't touched. It lifts itself when the time is up, survives a Pepe restart, and shows as timed out in Moderate your room's Banned & punished list with undo (or type !untimeout). A Pepe time-out from an admin stays as it is.
owner.cap.room_timeout.title: Time someone out
owner.cap.room_roles.howto: Make someone a moderator, admin or friend of your room, or take their role off - Pepe changes the room's oplist for you. Your own room only, never Pepe's admins or owners; every change asks first on the website and goes in your pad's event log.
owner.cap.room_roles.title: Give people room roles
owner.cap.room_mod.howto: In your own pad's room Pepe kicks, bans, punishes and mic-blocks for you (and lifts them). Type it in the room or use Moderate your room on the owner page - it lists who's in the room and who is banned or blocked, with undo. Pepe's admins and owners (and Pepe) are off limits.
owner.cap.room_mod.title: Moderate people in your room
owner.cap.room_vibe_web.howto: The same as !roomvibe: the room type (chill, fight, music...), how Pepe treats roasts, and the lock that stops him relearning it.
owner.cap.room_vibe_web.title: Pick your room's vibe on the website
owner.cap.room_moderation.howto: Global unblock (Pepe undoes mic blocks other people make in your room; his own stay), mic-hog policing, how many strikes someone gets before Pepe acts (inside the range Pepe's admins allow, 2-5 by default) and whether people can start community votes (!votekick, !voteblock, !votemod, !timeout).
owner.cap.room_moderation.title: Set how Pepe moderates your room
owner.cap.room_voice.title: Pick Pepe's voice in your room
owner.cap.room_voice.howto: Choose the voice Pepe speaks in by default in your room: one of the voices you own (bought in the voice store, or your own approved clone) or Pepe's default. If you lose the voice (a refund, a revoked clone, a takedown) the room goes back to Pepe's default by itself. Someone's own -v voice on !say still wins, and Pepe's lines in your room's voice never cost anyone a per-use price.
owner.cap.room_convo.title: Let Pepe start conversations when the room goes quiet
owner.cap.room_convo.howto: Conversation starters: when your room has been quiet for a while (5 to 240 minutes, you pick) with people still around, Pepe throws out a question or a topic - once per quiet spell. While the Auto-DJ plays here, the DJ opens the topic between songs instead.
owner.cap.room_voice_extras.title: Captions, alerts and DJ drops in your room
owner.cap.room_voice_extras.howto: Show a 🔊 caption of what Pepe says on the mic, let event alerts (heists, games and drops elsewhere) reach your room, and allow the DJ's short spoken drops between songs - each only in your room.
owner.cap.room_games.howto: Allow or stop trivia, pictionary, heists, the wheel, bingo, duels and brawls (with the arena and showdowns) and the casino tables (Hold'em and blackjack) in your room. Turf wars and the casino backend stay with Pepe's admins.
owner.cap.room_games.title: Choose which games run in your room
owner.cap.room_features.howto: Switch Pepe's welcome-back greetings on or off (and leave him a note about what to mention), set how chatty he is (off, low, normal, high), allow music and the DJ, song requests, !say, picking a voice (-v) and spoken (-mic) replies in your room.
owner.cap.room_features.title: Choose what Pepe does in your room
owner.cap.bridge.title: Connect your room to its pad page
owner.cap.bridge.howto: Choose what your pad's web page carries from the Camfrog room: website chat lines, push-to-talk voice clips, cam snapshots, room audio and mic transcripts.
owner.cap.topup_web.title: Top up your pad vault from the website
owner.cap.topup_web.howto: The Top up form on the owner page deposits PAT from your linked Camfrog name (or your PATV account if you haven't linked one) into the pad vault (minimum 1,000). It's exactly !padvault deposit: deposits never count as the pad's income, and a double click is one deposit.

vc.lead: Your own voice only, opt-in only, and you can delete it any time. Read the terms, confirm, then read a short text on the mic in a Camfrog room.

vc.t_what: What it is: a copy of your voice that Pepe can speak in - with !say, in soundboard clips and in packs, and as a ▶ preview in the voice store. Nothing else.
vc.t_where: Where it's kept: on PATV's own voice servers (a main one and a backup copy) - never sent to an outside AI company. The recording you make here is kept as proof of your consent.
vc.t_control: You're in control: it starts unlisted, and only you decide whether others can use it, for how much, whether it may say anything they type (off unless you turn it on) and whether pad owners can put it on soundboards.
vc.t_money: You get paid: 30% of every paid use by default (you pick 10-50%), 20% of every unlock, 15% of packs with your voice - held 24 h, then paid daily.
vc.t_never: Never: someone else's voice, a celebrity or an impression, anyone under 18, political endorsements, fraud or pretending to be you in DMs, sexual content. A credible report of any of these means it's deleted.
vc.t_delete: Delete it any time: here or with !clonemyvoice delete. It stops working everywhere at once, is deleted from both voice servers, anyone who unlocked it gets half their PAT back, and the recording is deleted within 30 days. We keep a record that you consented and when you withdrew it.
vc.t_privacy: No voiceprint: the check that the same person read the whole text runs in memory and nothing about your voice's characteristics is stored.

oadm.title: AI judge rulings
oadm.lede: Pepe's AI judge only proposes an outcome. The site keeps the proposal, runs the dispute window and settles the items it owns when the window ends undisputed; an item that still lives in Pepe turns due and Pepe settles it. A disputed call waits for an admin. Every action here is confirmed, keyed (a double click runs once) and written to the admin audit log.

oadm.owner.pepe: Pepe (the item still lives in Pepe)
oadm.no_evidence: No evidence was sent with this proposal.
oadm.act.uphold_help: Uphold the judge's call and settle it now, without waiting for the window.
oadm.act.override_help: Settle with a different outcome. A reason is required.
oadm.act.void_help: Void the item: every stake is refunded. A reason is required.
oadm.act.extend_help: Give people longer to dispute the call.
oadm.act.reask_help: Drop this call and have Pepe judge the item again.
oadm.why.pepe_owned: The item still lives in Pepe, so the site can't settle it.

oadm.pepe_room: This item still lives in Pepe: settle a disputed call in the room with {!cmd}.
oadm.no_disputes_help: People in the item dispute a call from its page (or with !market dispute / !wager dispute in the room) while the window is open.
oadm.m.uphold: Settle {ref} now with the judge's call, {outcome}? This pays out (or tells Pepe to) and can't be undone here.
oadm.m.override: Settle {ref} with a different outcome instead of the judge's {outcome}? This pays out and can't be undone here.
oadm.m.void: Void {ref}? Every stake is refunded and the judge's call ({outcome}) is dropped. This can't be undone here.
oadm.m.extend: Keep the dispute window on {ref} open for longer?
oadm.m.reask: Drop this call on {ref} and have Pepe judge it again? Its disputes go with it.
oadm.m.reject_dispute: Reject this dispute on {ref}? It stays on the record, marked rejected, and stops counting. If it was what escalated the call, the window reopens for at least 15 minutes.

adm.policy.title: Policy scheduler
adm.policy.help: The economy's clock-driven policy engines: the treasury (the Monday 04:00 UTC surplus waterfall and the daily release), the monetary day (the Fed band, the Monday guarantee, issuance, the activity rewards) and the burn accrual. Each engine is off (Pepe runs it), a dry run (the site records what would move), shadow (the site plans alongside Pepe and compares every period) or live (the site runs it, Pepe doesn't). Live and back only through Pepe: !econ engines cutover / rollback. Runbook: docs/policy-engines-cutover-runbook.md. Amounts are PAT, the site's points.
adm.policy.owner_only: Changing a mode is a Pepe owner's: your account needs a linked Camfrog login with Pepe's owner role. Admins can look.
adm.policy.not_engines: Retired, subsumed and staying in Pepe
adm.policy.pause_help: The kill switch for a site engine. A paused engine runs nothing on the site: a live one's due periods are recorded as missed (nothing is handed back to Pepe, its mode stays as it is). Resume lets only the current period run, flagged late; older ones stay missed. Pepe owners only, with your password; every pause is logged and every admin is told. From the server's shell, with no role needed: node tools/policy-backend.js --actor=NAME pause ENGINE --note WHY (and resume).
adm.policy.missed_help: Periods the site didn't run at their time: it was down, or the engine was paused. Only the current period ever runs late; these stay missed.
adm.policy.whitelist: Fields a shadow comparison may differ on
adm.policy.whitelist_help: A shadow period is clean when the engine diff is empty and the site's boundary snapshot (taken before Pepe moves a leg) matches Pepe's report - his plan, his inputs and the site's own decisions (the Monday guarantee) - everywhere except these. Each one applies only under its condition: it is post-move, or no enabled rule reads it, and a test proves it.
adm.pcfg.title: Policy settings
adm.pcfg.help: Every economy setting in one place (the site's policy config store): its value, unit and bounds, when a change applies (now or from the next period), whether a policy engine reads it, and who changed it last. Until the hand-over (H1) these are Pepe's: the site mirrors his pushes and is read-only here; each reader compares the site's value with the one it gets from Pepe (the dual read, below). Once the site owns them a Pepe owner changes them here, with a note and the account password; settings an engine reads are frozen from 03:40 UTC until that day's runs are done. A fraction is shown and entered as a percent. Amounts are PAT, the site's points.
adm.pcfg.diff_help: What Pepe pushes against what the site's settings list knows: keys on one side only, values the site's checks would refuse, and two of his pushes that disagree on a key. It must be empty before the hand-over.
adm.pcfg.dual_help: Each reader (the capital cut-off, the loan terms, the Fed's numbers, the funding sync, the policy engines) compares the value Pepe pushed with the site's own and keeps using Pepe's until the hand-over. Every difference is listed with both values; a clean day shows its checks with no differences.
adm.pcfg.pause_help: The kill switch for a site feature. A paused cfg refuses every change of these settings (the readers keep reading them). Pepe owners only, with your password; every pause is logged and every admin is told. From the server's shell, with no role needed: node tools/policy-backend.js --actor=NAME pause cfg --note WHY (and resume).
adm.rcfg.title: Pad-vault payout recipe
adm.rcfg.help: Each pad vault pays out a daily budget (its payout rate × its balance), split into five slices. Each slice pays only what was earned that day. With Unpaid shares fund room games on, whatever the owner, gang and streamer slices didn't pay that day is added to the room-games prize pool (the raffle, top mic of the hour, pictionary). What the games don't award stays in the vault. Changes apply from the next daily payout (the status below shows when it runs); today's prize pool doesn't change. Pepe picks a saved change up within about 5 minutes. Dry-run the next payout in chat with !econ recipe preview.
