owners.title: Pad owners guide
owners.og: Run a pad on PATV: a home for your community with a feed, a stage, a vault that pays your regulars, and Pepe as your co-host.
owners.lead: A pad is your community's own corner of PATV: a page, a feed of posts, a stage for live streams and a vault of PAT points that rewards your regulars. You run it, and Pepe, PATV's host, helps. Brand new to PATV? The quick tour just below explains the basics.
owners.new_h: New here? PATV in a minute
owners.new_lead: Never used PATV before? Here's what the rest of this guide takes for granted, in plain words.
owners.new.patv_d: PATV (Public Access TV) is a hub of pads: online communities, each with a page, a feed of posts, a stage for live streams and, if it likes, a connected chat room. Anyone can join in, watch, post and play.
owners.new.pad_d: One community on PATV, like a club with its own clubhouse. It has an address (p/name), its own members and its own house rules. Whoever creates a pad is its owner, and that could be you.
owners.new.pat_d: PATV's points. You earn them by taking part: chatting, playing games, unlocking achievements, spinning the wheel and more. You spend them on things on the site: boosts, stage slots, cosmetics, games and prizes in the prize shop. You can also get them as a thank-you when you donate to PATV. They're points for fun, with no cash value.
owners.new.pepe_d: PATV's host: a friendly frog who chats, runs games, plays music and helps keep rooms safe. On your pad, he's your co-host.
owners.new.vault_d: A pot of PAT that belongs to a pad, not to a person. It fills up as people spend and take part in the pad, and each day it shares some out to the people who keep the pad going, you included.
owners.new.tiers_d: Optional upgrades for a pad, paid in PAT. Prime Time adds a badge, a theme, extra stage slots and a soundboard; Prime Time Plus adds a live Camfrog chat room with Pepe in it. Every pad works and earns without them.
owners.new_more: Bump into a word you don't know? The {!link} at the bottom explains every one.
owners.art_alt: Pepe in his host's top hat
owners.what_lead: PATV is the hub, and pads are where communities actually live, each with its own address, its own regulars and its own rules. Here's what you get when you open one.
owners.what.page_t: A home with your name on it
owners.what.page_d: Your own address (p/name), an avatar, a banner and a colour. Add up to {n} house rules of your own on top of Padiquette (the rules every pad follows), and hand out flair to your members.
owners.what.feed_d: Your pad's wall of posts: photos, clips and chat from your members, all in one place. Pepe can join the conversation, and his automatic filter holds anything sketchy until you've had a look.
owners.what.stage_t: A stage anyone can go live on
owners.what.stage_d: Your pad's live channel. Members go live from OBS (free streaming software), a web browser, YouTube or Twitch. You set up to {n} slots (places on the stage people can book) and their price, or keep them free, approve bookings and feature the stream that matters.
owners.what.vault_t: A vault that pays your people
owners.what.vault_d: Every pad has one, connected to a chat room or not: a pot of PAT that belongs to your pad. It fills when people spend PAT and take part in your pad, and every day it shares some out to you, your streamers and your regulars (the members who keep coming back).
owners.what.chat_d: Already have a live chat room where your crowd hangs out? Connect it. Its chat, mic clips, cam snapshots and transcripts show up on your pad's page, Pepe moves into the room, and PAT spent there fills your vault too.
owners.what.chat_plus: Connecting a Camfrog room takes 💎 Prime Time Plus.
owners.what.panel_d: Your control room: the vault, your earnings, the stage, Prime Time and every Pepe setting that's yours, on one page, with a plain explanation on every card.
owners.earn_lead: Run a lively pad and it rewards you. Every pad earns: even a basic pad has a feed, a stage and a vault, and when people show up and take part, PAT flows into the vault and back out to the people who made it happen. PAT is points for fun inside PATV, with no cash value.
owners.earn.s1_t: People spend PAT and take part in your pad
owners.earn.s1_d: When someone spends PAT in your pad (a boost, a stage slot, a gift, Prime Time chip-ins or, in a connected chat room, Pepe's paid commands, songs, voices and heist gear), half lands in your vault. The other half goes to Fort Knox, PATV's big shared vault.
owners.earn.s2_t: The vault shares out PAT every day
owners.earn.s2_d: Each day your vault pays out up to {rate}% of what's in it (you choose anywhere from {min}% to {max}%). That payout is split five ways: owner {owner}% (that's you), streamers {streamers}%, regulars {people}%, the gang that controls the room {gang}% and prizes for room games {games}%.
owners.earn.games_unpaid: Shares that aren't earned on a day (no owner around, no gang, no verified viewers) top up the room-games prizes until the next payout instead; whatever the games don't award stays in the vault.
owners.earn.s3_d: Be active on {days} of the last 7 days, and keep your pad busy on {active} of them, and the owner's {owner}% is yours. Either place counts: on the pad (posting, commenting, streaming on its stage or moderating, with 3 or more members active there that day) or in a connected chat room (being in the room while it's busy). It's capped at {cap}% of what your pad takes in on an average day, so it grows as your pad gets busier.
owners.earn.activity: Activity bonus. PATV adds extra PAT to busy pads' vaults, based on real activity: posts that get upvotes and comments from real members, streams people watch, and chat and mic time in a connected room. It's never more than the pad pays out.
owners.earn.donate: Donations. Anyone can donate PAT to your vault from the pad page.
owners.earn.sb: Your soundboard. Prime Time pads get their own soundboard: short sound clips people pay PAT to play. Most of every paid play of your pad's own clips goes into its vault (Pepe plays them in a connected chat room).
owners.earn.launch: A head start. While your pad is new, PATV matches the PAT you put into its vault, and newcomers get a welcome gift of PAT when they visit.
owners.earn.profile: Your profile has a vault too. Your own profile page has a vault, just like a pad. What others spend on your profile, donations and the activity bonus fill it, and it pays you when your posts get real engagement from others.
owners.earn.fair: Fair by design: putting in your own PAT, donations and your own spending never raise your share, and when you spend in your own pad it all goes to Fort Knox. Rewards come from other people actually showing up.
owners.earn.needs: No upgrade and no chat room needed: every pad has a vault and earns from its activity.
owners.earn.paused: Pad vaults are paused right now. Payouts start again when they reopen.
owners.earn.economy: Curious where every PAT comes from and where it goes? How PAT works shows it all.
owners.pepe_lead: Pepe is PATV's host: a frog who chats on the site and in connected chat rooms. He's quick, warm and a little chaotic. He learns your room's vibe, whether it's a fight room or a support room, remembers your regulars and keeps the energy up when things go quiet. He roasts people because he likes them, and they can tell.
owners.pepe.eng1: Greets regulars with something he actually remembers about them.
owners.pepe.eng2: Starts a conversation when the room goes quiet, once per quiet spell, after a wait you choose.
owners.pepe.eng3: Runs the games: trivia, pictionary, heists (team jobs from Grand Theft Frogger, PATV's crime game), the wheel, bingo, duels and card tables.
owners.pepe.eng4: DJs, takes song requests and judges mic challenges (contests on the mic), with prizes from your vault.
owners.pepe.eng5: Announces it in your room when a stream on your pad goes live.
owners.pepe.mod1: Kicks, bans, mutes, times out and fines (takes PAT from rule-breakers) for you. Type it in the room or click it in your owner panel; every action is written down in your moderation log.
owners.pepe.mod2: Polices mic hogs (people who won't give up the mic) with a strike count you set.
owners.pepe.mod3: Calls out moderators who abuse their powers, in the open, and says what he did and why.
owners.pepe.mod4: Lets your room vote to kick, block or time someone out, if you switch community votes on.
owners.pepe.mod5: Holds sketchy posts on your feed for you to check. Every call can be reversed.
owners.pepe.never: One thing he never does: ban anyone on his own. People make the calls. You outrank him, and your override clears his record.
owners.can_h: What you can do with Pepe
owners.can_lead: Pick what you want to do. Each card links to the commands (what you type in chat to get Pepe to do things) for your connected chat room, and to the full owner reference.
owners.goal.grow.d: Make newcomers feel like regulars and give regulars a reason to come back.
owners.goal.grow.i1: Welcome-back greetings, with a note on what Pepe should mention
owners.goal.grow.i2: Conversation starters when the room goes quiet
owners.goal.grow.i3: Pepe posting in your pad's feed, as often as you like
owners.goal.grow.i4: Boosts: spend PAT to push your pad up the front page
owners.goal.fun.d: Switch on the games and music your crowd loves, room by room.
owners.goal.fun.i1: Trivia, pictionary, heists, the wheel and bingo
owners.goal.fun.i2: Hold'em and blackjack tables, duels and brawls
owners.goal.fun.i3: Mic challenges, judged by Pepe and paid from your vault
owners.goal.fun.i4: Music, song requests and the DJ's drops between songs
owners.goal.show.d: Give your streamers a real stage and capture the best moments.
owners.goal.show.i1: Stage slots, prices, bookings and a featured stream
owners.goal.show.i2: Cam snapshots, cam clips and mic clips
owners.goal.show.i3: Captions of what Pepe says on the mic
owners.goal.show.i4: A soundboard of lines and clips (Prime Time)
owners.goal.safe.d: Run your room your way, with Pepe doing the clicking.
owners.goal.safe.i1: Kick, ban, punish, mic block and unblock
owners.goal.safe.i2: Time-outs in your room only, up to 24 hours
owners.goal.safe.i4: Mic-hog policing, community votes and the automatic feed filter
owners.goal.vibe.d: Tell Pepe what kind of room this is, and he'll fit right in.
owners.goal.vibe.i1: The room's vibe and how hard Pepe roasts
owners.goal.vibe.i2: The language Pepe speaks in your room
owners.goal.vibe.i3: Pepe's voice in your room, from voices you own
owners.goal.vibe.i4: What Pepe knows about your room, and what he forgets
owners.goal.vault.d: A full vault means bigger prizes and better payouts for everyone.
owners.goal.vault.i1: Add your own PAT to the vault, on the site or in chat
owners.goal.vault.i2: PATV matches what you add while your pad is new
owners.goal.vault.i3: Your payout rate, from {min}% to {max}% a day
owners.goal.vault.i4: Donations from anyone who loves the place
owners.svc_lead: A connected chat room is a live chat room linked to your pad: Pepe works in it, and your pad's page shows what's happening there. Each chat service gets its own command guide.
owners.svc.camfrog_d: A live video chat app with rooms. Pepe sits in the room, and your pad page carries its chat, mic, cams and transcripts.
owners.tiers_lead: Every pad earns without an upgrade. Prime Time and Prime Time Plus are optional upgrades, paid in PAT, {days} days at a time. Anyone can chip in to keep them on, so your regulars can keep the lights on together, and when someone else chips in, half of what they pay lands in your pad's vault.
owners.pt_d: Lights up a whole pad: a badge, a theme, an intro, extra stage slots and a soundboard.
owners.pp_d: Everything in Prime Time, plus connecting your pad to a live Camfrog chat room with Pepe in it. He can be in {max} rooms at once, so there are only {max} Plus pads.
owners.pp_soldout: Sold out right now. Join the waitlist on the Prime Time page.
owners.end_lead: Creating a pad takes a minute, and it can earn from day one. Connect a chat room later if you like.
owners.ref_note: Want every command and switch in one list? See the {!link}.
owners.gl_lead: Every PATV word on this page, in plain English.
owners.gl.pat_d: PATV's points. Earned by taking part (chatting, playing, achievements, the wheel…), spent on things on the site (boosts, stage slots, cosmetics, games, prize-shop prizes), or given as a thank-you for donating. No cash value.
owners.gl.pad_d: A community on PATV with its own page, feed, stage and vault, and optionally a connected chat room. The person who runs it is its owner.
owners.gl.vault_d: A pad's own pot of PAT. Spending and activity in the pad fill it; every day it pays some out. It holds up to {cap} PAT; anything above that goes to Fort Knox.
owners.gl.payout_d: The PAT a vault shares out each day: {rate}% of its balance unless the owner picks another rate, anywhere from {min}% to {max}%.
owners.gl.split_d: How each day's payout is shared: the owner {owner}% (the person who runs the pad), streamers {streamers}% (people who go live on the pad), regulars {people}% (members who keep coming back and taking part), the gang {gang}% (the gang that controls the room) and games {games}% (prizes for games played in the room).
owners.gl.boost_d: PAT spent to push a pad up the front page for a while. Anyone can boost a pad they like; half goes into its vault.
owners.gl.stage_d: A pad's live video spot. Members book a slot and stream to it; the owner sets the slots and prices and picks the featured stream.
owners.gl.flair_d: Small coloured labels a pad makes for its own people and posts, shown next to names and post titles on that pad.
owners.gl.prime_d: An optional pad upgrade, paid in PAT: a badge, a theme, an intro, extra stage slots and a soundboard.
owners.gl.plus_d: Everything in Prime Time, plus a live Camfrog chat room connected to the pad with Pepe in it. Spots are limited, because Pepe can only be in so many rooms at once.
owners.gl.chat_d: A live chat room linked to a pad. Pepe works in it, its chat and clips show on the pad's page, and PAT spent there fills the pad's vault.
owners.gl.room_d: A live chat room in a chat app, such as a Camfrog video chat room. A room is where people talk live; a pad is its home on the web.
owners.gl.pepe_d: PATV's host, a frog bot. He chats, runs games and music, helps moderate, and posts on pads. He never bans anyone on his own.
owners.gl.gang_d: A crew of players in Grand Theft Frogger, PATV's crime game played in chat. Gangs can take control of rooms, and the gang in control gets a share of that pad's payout.
owners.gl.fortknox_d: PATV's big shared vault. Half of what's spent in pads goes here, and it funds rewards across the site. (It's also what bank heists go after.)
owners.gl.padiquette_d: The rules every pad on PATV follows. Owners can add house rules of their own on top.
pad.create.owners_guide: New to running a pad? Read {!link}.
premium.owners_note: Running a pad? {!link} shows what pads are for and how they earn PAT.
help.owners_note: Run a pad? {!link} shows what Pepe can do for your room.
owner.grp_topic_why: The topic line of your pad's chat room: set it yourself, or let Pepe keep it fresh with the auto-topic.
owner.set_topic_why: Pepe puts it in your connected room's topic. Up to 200 characters and 6 changes an hour, free for you (in chat: !topic in your room). Slurs, threats, phone numbers and addresses are refused, and so are pad codes (PATV-...): those you type into the topic yourself.
owner.topic_unknown: Pepe hasn't seen this room's topic yet.
owner.set_autotopic_why: Pepe writes a new one-line topic about what the room is talking about. Your own topic pauses it for 6 hours; switch it on again to resume sooner.
owner.autotopic_master_off: Pepe's admins have the auto-topic off everywhere right now.
owner.autotopic_floor: Pepe's admins allow every {n} minutes at the most often.
owner.set_autotopic_every_why: The least time between two auto-topics.
owner.set_stt_language_why: The language Pepe transcribes mic-ups in here (mic transcripts, captions, what he knows was said). Auto detects it per clip; pick one for a room that speaks it. Someone with their own language set by Pepe's admins keeps it.
owner.site_why: What Pepe does on your pad's feed: his own posts, his comments and his moderation. Each follows the default until you change it, and you can go back to the default any time. Changes save at once; Pepe follows them from his next feed check.
owner.site_feed_why: Off = Pepe doesn't post, comment or answer anyone on this pad's feed (his moderation is separate).
owner.site_posts_why: Pepe posts in your pad now and then: recaps of the room, questions, music picks, news, the day's snaps.
owner.site_post_kinds_why: The kinds of post Pepe may make here.
owner.site_posts_per_day_why: At most this many of his own posts here a day.
owner.site_labels: Flair and tags on his posts
owner.site_labels_why: Pepe labels his posts with your pad's own post flairs and tags (never ones you don't have). Off = no labels, except a flair your pad requires.
owner.site_announce_why: A line in your pad when a stream goes live on it, and when a queue starts its next title.
owner.site_replies_why: Pepe answers when someone mentions him in your pad.
owner.site_comments_why: Pepe joins in on fresh posts in your pad without being asked.
owner.site_comment_rate_why: How many comments a day and how long between them.
owner.site_rate_low: Low (4 a day, an hour apart)
owner.site_automod_why: Pepe reads new posts and comments and acts on your pad's rules (or the site guidelines). Every action lands in your queue, and you can reverse it.
owner.site_automod_level_why: What happens to minor, serious and severe problems. Severe ones are always at least hidden.
owner.site_lvl_standard: Standard (flag to your queue, hide severe)
owner.site_locked: A site admin locked this for your pad.
owner.site_floor_why: The site's own protections. They work the same on every pad and nobody can switch them off here.
owner.site_floor_reports: Reports and the site admins' review queue
owner.site_floor_takedown: The TAKE IT DOWN removal process
owner.site_floor_csam: Child-safety escalation to the site admins
owner.site_floor_severe_hidden: With moderation on: severe problems are always at least hidden
owner.site_floor_admin_lock: A site admin's lock on your pad's settings
owner.site_more: More of Pepe's feed settings (quiet hours, thread depth, pictures) are in your pad settings.
owner.cap.room_topic.title: Set your room's topic
owner.cap.room_topic.howto: In your pad's chat room, !topic is free for you (up to 200 characters, 6 changes an hour). Pad codes (PATV-...) can't go through Pepe; a pending one in the topic stays there. Your topic pauses the auto-topic for 6 hours.
owner.cap.room_topic_web.title: Set your room's topic from the website
owner.cap.room_topic_web.howto: The topic box on this page: the same checks and limits as !topic, and the room's topic as Pepe last saw it.
owner.cap.room_autotopic.title: Let Pepe keep your room's topic fresh
owner.cap.room_autotopic.howto: Switch the auto-topic on or off and pick how often (every 15 minutes to every 3 hours), never more often than Pepe's admins allow. Until you choose, your room follows Pepe's default.
owner.cap.room_stt.title: Pick the language Pepe transcribes your room's mic in
owner.cap.room_stt.howto: Follow Pepe's default, auto-detect each clip, or fix one language for a room that speaks it. It's the transcription only: the language Pepe answers in is his chat language.
owner.cap.room_tts.title: Pick the language Pepe speaks in your room
owner.cap.room_tts.howto: Pepe speaks each line in the language it's written in by default. Fix one language for a room that speaks it, or go back to the default. A voice that can't speak your pick speaks English instead, and your owner page says so.
owner.cap.web_room_topic.title: Set the room topic
owner.cap.web_room_topic.howto: Type your room's topic on this page and Pepe sets it in your connected room.
owner.cap.web_pad_site.title: Choose what Pepe does on your pad's page
owner.cap.web_pad_site.howto: His own posts (and which kinds), go-live announcements, answering mentions, commenting on his own, and his feed moderation - each with Reset to default.
owner.cap.web_chat_history.title: Choose how far back visitors read your pad’s chat
owner.cap.web_chat_history.howto: Pad settings › 💬 Chat: how far back visitors can scroll (off, a time, or everything your tier keeps), whether the chat can be searched or downloaded, and whether your room’s mods read all of it.
owner.chat_row: What visitors see of your pad’s chat
owner.chat_locked: A site admin locked these settings.
owner.cap.web_pad_filter.title: Switch on the content filter for your pad
owner.cap.web_pad_filter.howto: A fast filter that checks new posts and comments for slurs, people's personal details, threats and spam as they're sent. Choose what it does with each: allow, flag to your queue, hide until you review it, or block with a message.
owner.flt_why: A fast word-and-pattern filter that checks new posts and comments on your pad the moment they're sent: slurs and hate terms, people's personal details, threats and spam. It's the floor. Pepe's feed moderation (above) is an optional extra that runs after it. Your own posts are never filtered, and neither are the site staff's.
owner.flt_master_off: The site admins have paused the content filter for now. Your choices are kept and apply again when it's back.
owner.flt_on_why: Off unless you switch it on. On = new posts and comments here are checked against the categories below.
owner.flt_cats_h: What it does with each kind
owner.flt_cats_why: Flag = it goes in your queue and nothing changes yet. Hide = it's hidden here until you look. Block = the writer can't send it and is told why.
owner.flt_cat_hate_why: Slurs and hateful phrases, including spelled-out, spaced-out and look-alike versions.
owner.flt_cat_doxxing_why: Phone numbers, ID and card numbers, IP addresses, emails and street addresses. An email or an address on its own is only ever flagged. Prices, dates and PAT amounts don't count.
owner.flt_cat_threats_why: Threats of violence, telling someone to kill themselves, threats to dox or swat someone.
owner.flt_cat_selfharm_why: Never a punishment. The writer gets a private note with helplines and their post goes up as normal.
owner.flt_cat_spam_why: Floods of links, repeated text or mentions, the same post again and again, and PAT or crypto scam lines.
owner.flt_act_hide: Hide it until I review it
owner.flt_sh_flag: The note, and flag it to my queue
owner.flt_queue: Flagged and hidden posts and comments also land in your pad's report queue and the site admins' queue. The writer is told, and can appeal.
js.owner.site_saved: Saved - Pepe follows it from his next feed check.
js.owner.flt_saved: Saved - it applies to the next post or comment.
js.owner.flt_released_msg: Released - the writer has been told.
bx.pad.label: The pad it belongs to
bx.pad.pick_note: It shows on that pad's page and under that pad in the lists.
polls.f_note_pad: One poll runs per pad at a time. Give it at least 2 options.
pad.bets.empty: Nothing here yet. Start a prediction market, a betting pool or a poll for this pad.
owner.set_tts_language_why: The language Pepe speaks in on the mic here. Auto (Pepe's default) speaks each line in the language it's written in; pick one for a room that speaks it. This is the voice only - the language he chats in is the Language setting.
owner.tts_auto: Auto (the language each line is written in)
owner.tts_fallback: The room's voice ({voice}) can't speak {lang}, so Pepe speaks English here until the voice changes.
owner.master_off_why: It's off in every room right now. Your setting is kept and comes back when they switch it on again.

inc.title: Privacy
inc.lead: Choose how Pepe and the website treat your chat identity.
inc.what: Incognito is Pepe's “don't remember me” switch for your chat identity. It's off by default. While it's on:
inc.what_memory: Pepe doesn't remember anything new you say - in a room, in PMs or in DMs with him. Lines still waiting to be remembered are thrown away when you switch it on.
inc.what_web: The website shows you as “someone” on live room pages, and your chat lines aren't shown there.

staking.card.staker_so_far: in {days} d (an APR once there's 7 days of history)
staking.wf.how: Every Monday each vault settles its week. Its surplus is what the protocol's own shares in the vault are worth above what the protocol put in, at most the vault's value above its target size and its free cash. It first repays anything the vault borrowed from the Federal Reserve, then {share}% of the rest goes to that vault's stakers{!cap}; the remainder goes half to the Federal Reserve while it's below its ceiling and the rest to the incentive budget that pays everyone's rewards. Your shares already carry your part of the vault's growth in the share price, so the weekly payout is extra: it's {share}% of the protocol's part, not {share}% of everything the vault earned. It's paid in PAT to your stash's balance; it doesn't change your shares.
staking.wf.cap: , capped at {cap}% a year on what they staked
staking.wf.ceiling: Separately, each daily cut-off keeps stakers' share-price growth to the APR ceiling ({ceil}% a year) and moves the rest to the protocol. Losses aren't capped: a losing day lowers stakers' value in full, and they then recover with the vault, uncapped, until it's back at its previous high.
staking.wf.ceiling_cushion: Separately, each daily cut-off keeps stakers' share-price growth to the APR ceiling ({ceil}% a year) and moves the rest to the protocol. On a losing day the protocol gives stakers back up to what it kept from them over the last {days} days; a bigger loss still lowers their value.
staking.wf.ceiling_off: There's no daily APR ceiling: the share price carries each vault's full growth and its full losses. Stakers ride the House's swings with it, including its big payouts like the Monday Pepeball draw, which can pull the House's share price down for a few days while the House earns it back.
staking.wf.table_help: Paid to stakers is the stakers' share (up to the cap, when there is one), split over the stashes as described above. The rest goes to the Federal Reserve (repaying any Fed loan first) and to the incentive budget. A vault whose protocol shares are worth less than the protocol put in has no surplus until it earns that back.
staking.div.title: The older daily dividend (before the weekly settlement)
staking.div.help: Before the weekly settlement, a daily protocol dividend paid the protocol's earnings straight to the Federal Reserve. Stakers weren't paid from it.
staking.mine.pl_none: Not known yet: part of this stake is older than the cost history
staking.mine.note: Staked is what went in minus what came out (a stake refunded at the staker limit isn't counted). P/L is the value now plus what came out, minus what went in. A dash means part of the stake is older than the cost history, so these aren't known yet. Payouts (the weekly staking payout and any staking correction, last 7 days / all time) are paid into the stash's balance, not into the stake, so they're not in the value or the P/L.
adm.stk.title: Staking: APR ceiling, weekly payout and staker limit
adm.stk.help: Daily APR ceiling (0 = off): at each daily cut-off, stakers' share-price growth above it moves to the protocol; losses are never capped. Off, stakers keep each vault's full growth and carry its full losses, the House's Monday draws included. Protocol cushion (built, off; only matters while the ceiling is on): on a losing day the protocol gives stakers back, from its own shares, up to what the ceiling took from them over the last few days. Weekly payout cap (0 = no cap): limits the stakers' share of each vault's weekly surplus (Pepe's staker_share_pct, 20% unless changed). The payout is shared by PAT-days (how much each stash held and for how long), so a stake made just before Monday earns almost nothing. With no cap, a week that isn't wholly time-weighted - the first one (the PAT-days only count from their start), or one whose PAT-days don't cover all of the time since the last settlement - is held to the 25% reference cap automatically: nothing to do by hand. The tracker below shows what a 25% cap would have paid each week. Auto under the staker limit makes Auto deposits and rebalances obey the staker limit that direct stakes obey. The weekly cap is changed here (Pepe runs !econ set wf_staker_cap_pct, owner-only) and applies from the next weekly settlement; the other three are set on Pepe's admin panel and shown here.

staking.wf.weighted: The stakers' part is shared by PAT-days: what each stash had staked in the vault, times the days it held it during the week. A stake made just before Monday earns almost nothing that week; a stash that held all week gets its full part, even if it unstaked before Monday.

staking.wf.partial_gap: This week isn't fully time-weighted: the PAT-days don't cover all of the time since the last settlement (they began part-way through it, or it spans more weeks than are kept), so a stake counts only for the time they cover.
staking.wf.partial_cap: With no weekly cap set, a week that isn't fully time-weighted, like this one, still holds the stakers' payout to {cap}% a year on what they staked.
staking.wf.fallback: † No weekly cap is set, but that week wasn't fully time-weighted (the first week of the time-weighting, or one it couldn't cover), so the stakers' payout in that vault was held to {cap}% a year on what they staked.

adm.stk.track_help: Every settled week: the stakers' share of the surplus, what they were paid, and what a 25% APR cap on their (time-weighted) stake would have paid. What was paid above it would have gone to the Federal Reserve and the incentive budget. It's here to decide whether a weekly cap is needed again.
adm.stk.panel_note: The daily APR ceiling, the protocol cushion (and its window) and Auto under the staker limit are Pepe's admin-panel settings (Vaults: vault_ceil_apr as a fraction, 0.25 = 25% a year, 0 = off; vault_ceil_cushion; vault_ceil_cushion_days; vault_auto_staker_cap). This card shows what he pushed; it doesn't change them.
adm.stk.rt_help: Stashes that unstaked at the cut-off before the Monday 01:00 UTC Pepeball draw and staked again at the one after it. They skip the draw's drop in the House's price (and Auto's) for a day's PAT-days, and the other stakers carry it. Nothing stops it yet (no fee or lock-up); this shows whether it happens.
js.admstk.weighted_on: by PAT-days (how much each stash held and for how long) - this week settles {when} UTC
js.admstk.weighted_off: by the stakes at the settlement (no PAT-days recorded yet)
js.admstk.autocap_on: Auto deposits and rebalances obey it
js.admstk.autocap_off: Auto deposits skip it (direct stakes obey it)
js.admstk.track_none: No settled week reported by Pepe yet.
js.admstk.ask_cap_partial: Note: this is the first week of the time-weighting (PAT-days since {when} UTC), so it isn't fully time-weighted: a stake made just before they began weighs as if held since then. With no cap, Pepe still holds this week's settlement on {settle} UTC to the 25% reference cap, automatically; the stakers' full share applies from the first fully time-weighted week.
js.admstk.ask_cap_partial_gap: Note: this week isn't fully time-weighted - the PAT-days don't cover all of the time since the last settlement. With no cap, Pepe still holds this week's settlement on {settle} UTC to the 25% reference cap, automatically; the stakers' full share applies again from the next fully time-weighted week.
js.admstk.pd_from_partial: {when} UTC - this week isn't fully time-weighted: with no weekly cap, its settlement on {settle} UTC is held to the 25% reference cap
js.admstk.pd_none: not started yet (the first cut-off after the deploy starts it)

admin.stepup.owner_help: Pepe owners only: your account needs a linked Camfrog login with Pepe's owner role. Every adjustment asks for your account password.
admin.owner_switch: Changing it is a Pepe owner's job - it holds members' PAT. Your account needs a linked Camfrog login with Pepe's owner role; Admins can still see everything here.
admin.codes.owner_only: Saving a code is a Pepe owner's job - a code is PAT members redeem. Your account needs a linked Camfrog login with Pepe's owner role; Admins can still see and delete codes.
admbk.title: Backends
admbk.lede: Where each feature lives - on Pepe or on publicaccess.tv - and the switches that move it. Pepe's own admin panel shows these switches read-only; they are changed here. Nothing moves on the site from this page: a switch sets the site's side (whether it takes the feature over) and records where it should live. Pepe moves a feature himself only for the switches he follows (shown below); for the others a Pepe owner runs the hand-over in chat with the command shown. The shell tools (tools/*-backend.js) stay the emergency path.
admbk.you_owner: You are a Pepe owner: you can switch every row.
admbk.you_admin: Rows marked owners hold members' PAT - only a Pepe owner switches them (an Admin account with a linked Camfrog login that has Pepe's owner role). You can switch the others.
admbk.handovers.help: The switch says where the feature should live; Lives on is where it is now. When the two differ, the feature still has to move: if Pepe follows the switch he does it at a quiet moment (no draw, heist or fight running); if not, a Pepe owner runs the command shown in chat.
admbk.audit: Every switch is written to the admin log: who, when, and what it was before.
admbk.casino: The casino is switched per room below (a Pepe owner's); its engines are on Admin › Games.
admbk.d.lotto: Holds the pot and the tickets (members' PAT). Pepe moves it between draws: on = his cutover (the pot leaves his lotto vault for the site), off = his rollback (the pot is booked back into Pepe).
admbk.d.stashes: Members' PAT in their personal vaults. Once the site owns them it is for good - only a detach on Pepe, if the site is ever gone.
admbk.d.gtf: Heist sheets, loadouts, avatars, PvP records and vault cracks. On lets Pepe hand them over when no heist or fight is running; off refuses new hand-overs and asks Pepe to take them back.
admbk.d.polls: The running poll and its votes. Off ends the site's ownership at once and Pepe runs the polls again.
admbk.d.cosdrops: Every event's drop chance, the daily cap and the gates. While the site owns the table, off asks Pepe to take it back (he gets the same numbers).
admbk.d.aijudge: On: Pepe's AI judge proposes outcomes to the site's oracle, with the dispute window here. Off: proposals are refused and he decides locally.
admbk.status.h: Cutovers done with a runbook (status only)
admbk.status.help: These hold members' PAT and are cut over live, step by step, with their runbook - there is no button for them here, as on Pepe's panel. Their site switches (a Pepe owner's) are on Admin › Economy and in the shell tools.
js.admbk.confirm_on: Move {name} to publicaccess.tv? Pepe follows this switch: he runs the hand-over at his next quiet moment.
js.admbk.confirm_off: Bring {name} back to Pepe? Pepe follows this switch: he runs the way back at his next quiet moment.
js.admbk.failed: That did not work - try again.
admin.backends_pointer: The hand-overs between Pepe and the site (the lotto, the stashes, GTF, polls, the drop table, the AI judge) and the casino's per-room switch are switched on Admin › Backends; Pepe's panel and chat only show them.
admin.padvault.admins: Fines and transfers are moderation: site Admins run them (with your password each time), like !padfine / !padmove in chat (owner answer of 2026-10-21).
admin.donpromo.owner_only: Creating, changing or ending a promo, and these settings, is a Pepe owner's job - a promo changes how much PAT a donation credits. Admins can see everything here.
admbk.reader.yes: Pepe reads these switches (last read {when}, Pepe {version}).
admbk.reader.stale: Pepe hasn't read these switches since {when} - nothing moves by itself; a Pepe owner runs each hand-over in chat with the command shown.
admbk.reader.never: Pepe doesn't read these switches yet (his update isn't live) - a switch here only sets the site's side. A Pepe owner runs each hand-over in chat with the command shown.
admbk.not_following: Pepe doesn't follow this switch yet - an owner moves it in chat:
admbk.waiting_chat: Not moved yet - a Pepe owner runs in chat:
admbk.again.unacted: This switch was made before Pepe followed it, so he leaves it alone - switch it again (the same way) to have him do it.
admbk.again.stuck: Pepe gave up on this switch after a day - switch it again (the same way) to have him try again.
admbk.again.moved: Pepe did this once and it was changed another way since (he never undoes that by himself) - switch it again (the same way) to have him do it again.
admbk.btn.again_off: Switch again: bring back to Pepe
js.admbk.confirm_again: Switch {name} again, the same way? Pepe follows this switch: he runs it at his next quiet moment.
js.admbk.confirm_on_chat: Set the site's side of {name} to take it over? Pepe doesn't follow this switch yet: nothing moves until a Pepe owner runs {cmd} in chat.
js.admbk.confirm_off_chat: Set the site's side of {name} back? Pepe doesn't follow this switch yet: it comes back only when a Pepe owner runs {cmd} in chat.
js.admbk.saved_chat: Saved. Now a Pepe owner runs {cmd} in chat to move it.
admbk.casino.help: Which rooms play blackjack and Hold'em on publicaccess.tv's casino (web players can sit at the same tables) and which on Pepe's own tables, and what the rooms Pepe joins later get. Nothing moves when it flips: a table still open on Pepe's old engine finishes first, and tables in flight on the site are settled by the site. Only a Pepe owner switches it (the casino holds members' PAT); Pepe follows the switch within a minute. In chat, !casino backend only shows the status while this switch works (an owner switches it there only while the site can't, and hands rooms back while the site isn't answering Pepe). The engines are on Admin › Games; the shell's emergency path is tools/casino-backend.js.
admbk.casino.not_following: Pepe doesn't follow these switches (his update isn't live yet, or he follows nothing right now), so nothing here would change - a Pepe owner runs !casino backend on|off in the room instead.
admbk.casino.stale: Pepe hasn't read these switches since {when} (Pepe {version}) - check that he is running and can reach publicaccess.tv; nothing here would change until he reads them again (within a minute once he does). While he can't reach the site, a Pepe owner can hand a room back to his own tables in chat:
admbk.casino.no_report: Pepe hasn't listed his rooms yet.
admbk.casino.not_joined: Pepe isn't in this room right now.
admbk.casino.all.on: Every room on the site's casino
js.admbk.casino_on: Play the casino on publicaccess.tv in {name}? Pepe switches it within a minute (a table still open on his old engine finishes first).
js.admbk.casino_off: Play the casino on Pepe's own tables in {name}? Pepe switches it within a minute.
js.admbk.casino_all_on: Play the casino on publicaccess.tv in every room Pepe listed, and in the rooms he joins later? He switches them within a minute.
js.admbk.casino_all_off: Play the casino on Pepe's own tables in every room Pepe listed, and in the rooms he joins later? He switches them within a minute.
rf.adm.house_owner: A PAT prize paid by the House is for Pepe owners only (the Admin class and Pepe's owner role on your linked Camfrog login). An item or a custom prize stays open to every admin.
hm.adm_route_unknown: unknown right now (the economy settings can't be read - sales are refused until they can)
admchat.title: Chat hub (break-glass)
admchat.lede: The chat hub's two switches: CHAT_HUB, the kill switch for all hub chat, and each pad's chat (v1 chat or the chat hub). The hub follows both through the seam.
admchat.you_owner: You're a Pepe owner: you can turn the chat hub and a pad's hub chat on and off.
admchat.you_admin: You're an admin: you can turn the chat hub or a pad's hub chat off. Turning them on is for Pepe owners (the Admin class and Pepe's owner role on a linked Camfrog login).
admchat.no_hub_call: This page never calls the chat hub, so it works while the hub is down: everything on it is this site's own.
admchat.reason: Reason for a change (required; kept in the admin audit log)
admchat.reason_ph: e.g. rollback: errors in the Lounge after the deploy
admchat.hub.help: On: the pads on the hub get the hub chat. Off: no hub chat anywhere - the hub refuses chat on hub pads and closes open chats, while the moderation screens, data export and account deletion keep working.
admchat.hub.needs: It needs these seam switches on first: {list}.
admchat.hub.owner_only: Only a Pepe owner turns the chat hub on.
admchat.pads.help: A pad on the hub gets the hub chat while the chat hub is on. Moving a pad back to v1 chat is any admin's, one click.
admchat.pads.none: No pad is on the chat hub.
admchat.pads.move_label: Move a site pad to the chat hub
admchat.pads.site_only: Only site pads move to the chat hub for now; Camfrog pads keep their v1 chat.
admchat.pads.owner_only: Only a Pepe owner moves a pad to the chat hub.
admchat.pads.unreadable: The pads can't be read right now. The chat hub switch above still works, and turning it off covers every pad.
admchat.pads.gone: not in the pad registry any more
admchat.pads.more: Only the first {n} are listed. Turning the chat hub off covers them all.
admchat.pads.choices_more: Only the first {n} site pads are listed (the pilot pads first).
admchat.lock.h: Interlock: the seam switches the chat hub needs
admchat.lock.help: The chat hub can go on only while all twelve are on, and none of them can go off while it is on (turn the chat hub off first).
admchat.lock.link: Change the seam switches on Bot keys & chat seam ›
